To address this limitation, we propose Diversified Unlearning, a distributional framework that represents a concept through a set of contextually diverse prompts rather than a single keyword. This richer representation enables more precise and robust unlearning. Through extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and state-of-the-art baselines, we demonstrate that integrating Diversified Unlearning as an add-on component into existing unlearning pipelines consistently achieves stronger erasure, better retention of unrelated concepts, and improved robustness against adversarial recovery attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Diversified Unlearning方法，通过使用多样化的提示集而非单一关键词来表示目标概念，解决文本到图像扩散模型中概念擦除的局限性问题。该方法作为即插即用组件可集成到现有擦除流程中，显著提升擦除效果、概念保留和对抗恢复攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于关键词的概念擦除方法存在本质缺陷：单个关键词仅代表概念的一个窄点估计，无法覆盖完整语义分布和潜在空间中纠缠的变化，导致擦除不精确且容易过度遗忘。视觉概念是多维的，可以用多种文本形式表达，且与相关概念存在重叠。
AI.method: 提出分布式的Diversified Unlearning框架，用一组上下文多样化的提示来表示概念，而非单一关键词。这种更丰富的表示能够实现更精确和鲁棒的擦除。可作为即插即用组件集成到现有擦除流程中。
AI.result: 通过在多个基准数据集和最先进的基线方法上的广泛实验，集成Diversified Unlearning组件后 consistently实现了更强的擦除效果、更好的无关概念保留能力，以及提高对对抗恢复攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Diversified Unlearning通过多样化的提示集表示概念，有效解决了关键词方法的核心局限，为文本到图像扩散模型的概念擦除提供了更优解决方案。

title: AIMER: Calibration-Free Task-Agnostic MoE Pruning
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models increase parameter capacity without proportional per-token compute, but the deployment still requires storing all experts, making expert pruning important for reducing memory and serving overhead. Existing task-agnostic expert pruning methods are typically calibration-dependent: they estimate expert importance from routing or activation statistics on a calibration set, which makes pruning outcomes sensitive to the choice of calibration set and adds substantial preprocessing cost. We introduce AIMER (\textbf{A}bsolute mean over root mean square \textbf{IM}portance for \textbf{E}xpert \textbf{R}anking), a simple calibration-free criterion that yields clear within-layer score separation and distinct expert stratification. Across 7B to 30B MoE language models at 25\% and 50\% pruning ratios over 16 benchmarks, AIMER consistently delivers competitive or stronger overall performance against state-of-the-art calibration-based expert pruning baselines with only 0.22--1.27 seconds for scoring the experts.

AI.tldr: AIMER是一种无需校准的专家剪枝方法，用于压缩MoE语言模型的参数容量。该方法通过计算专家重要性评分的均方根绝对均值来实现快速专家排名，在7B到30B规模的MoE模型上，在25%和50%剪枝比例下，于16个基准测试中实现了与先进校准方法相当或更强的性能，且评分仅需0.22-1.27秒。
AI.motivation: 现有任务无关的专家剪枝方法依赖校准集估计专家重要性，这导致剪枝结果对校准集选择敏感，并增加了预处理成本。因此需要一种无需校准的简单剪枝标准。
AI.method: 提出AIMER（Absolute mean over root mean square Importance for Expert Ranking）方法，这是一种无需校准的专家重要性评估标准，通过计算专家评分绝对均值与均方根的比值来实现层内分数分离和专家分层。
AI.result: 在7B到30B规模的MoE语言模型上，以25%和50%剪枝比例在16个基准测试中进行评估，AIMER一致性地实现了与最先进的校准基线方法相当或更强的整体性能，且专家评分仅需0.22-1.27秒。
AI.conclusion: AIMER作为一种简单、无需校准的专家剪枝方法，能够在显著降低计算开销的同时保持或提升模型性能，为MoE模型的高效部署提供了有效方案。

title: Proceedings of the 2nd Workshop on Advancing Artificial Intelligence through Theory of Mind
summary: This volume includes a selection of papers presented at the 2nd Workshop on Advancing Artificial Intelligence through Theory of Mind held at AAAI 2026 in Singapore on 26th January 2026. The purpose of this volume is to provide an open access and curated anthology for the ToM and AI research community.

AI.tldr: 这是AAAI 2026第二届"通过心智理论推进人工智能"研讨会论文集的编辑说明，介绍了论文集的来源和目的。
AI.motivation: 为心智理论(ToM)和AI研究社区提供开放获取的精选论文集，促进该领域学术交流。
AI.method: 该卷包含在2026年1月26日于新加坡AAAI 2026举办的第二届心智理论推进人工智能研讨会上的论文精选。
AI.result: 形成一个开放获取的精选论文集，供ToM和AI研究社区使用。
AI.conclusion: 本论文集作为该领域研究的重要资源，推动人工智能与心智理论的跨学科研究发展。

title: Balancing the Reasoning Load: Difficulty-Differentiated Policy Optimization with Length Redistribution for Efficient and Robust Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown exceptional reasoning capabilities, but they also suffer from the issue of overthinking, often generating excessively long and redundant answers.
  For problems that exceed the model's capabilities, LRMs tend to exhibit the overconfidence phenomenon, generating overly short but incorrect answers, which may contribute to suboptimal performance.
  To address these issues, we propose Difficulty-Differentiated Policy Optimization (DDPO), an efficient reinforcement learning algorithm that optimizes simple and complex tasks separately based on the overconfidence phenomenon.
  Specifically, it reduces the output length for simple tasks without compromising accuracy, while for complex tasks, it expands the exploration space to improve performance. We further derive the theoretical conditions for maximizing expected accuracy, which require the length distribution to closely approximate the optimal length and be as concentrated as possible. Based on these conditions, we propose using the difficulty-level average as a well-founded reference for length optimization.
  Extensive experiments on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks validate the superiority and effectiveness of DDPO. Compared to GRPO, DDPO reduces the average answer length by 12% while improving accuracy by 1.85% across multiple benchmarks, achieving a better trade-off between accuracy and length. The code is available at https://github.com/Yinan-Xia/DDPO.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型推理中的过度思考和过度自信问题，提出难度区分策略优化(DDPO)算法，根据任务难度分别优化简单和复杂任务，在保持精度的同时减少简单任务输出长度，扩展复杂任务探索空间。实验表明相比GRPO，DDPO平均答案长度减少12%，准确率提升1.85%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型(LRMs)存在两个关键问题：1) 过度思考 - 生成过于冗长的答案；2) 过度自信 - 对超出能力范围的问题给出过于简短但错误的答案。这两个问题导致模型性能次优。
AI.method: 提出难度区分策略优化(DDPO)算法：1) 基于过度自信现象，根据任务难度分别优化；2) 对简单任务减少输出长度而不损失准确率；3) 对复杂任务扩展探索空间以提升性能；4) 推导出最大化期望精度的理论条件，要求长度分布接近最优长度且尽可能集中；5) 提出使用难度级别平均值作为长度优化的可靠参考。
AI.result: 在域内和域外基准测试上进行广泛实验：相比GRPO，DDPO平均答案长度减少12%，准确率提升1.85%，实现了更好的精度-长度权衡。
AI.conclusion: DDPO通过难度区分的策略优化方法，成功解决了LRMs的过度思考和过度自信问题，在多个基准测试上验证了其有效性和优越性，代码已开源。

title: dTRPO: Trajectory Reduction in Policy Optimization of Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) introduce a new paradigm for language generation, which in turn presents new challenges for aligning them with human preferences. In this work, we aim to improve the policy optimization for dLLMs by reducing the cost of the trajectory probability calculation, thereby enabling scaled-up offline policy training. We prove that: (i) under reference policy regularization, the probability ratio of the newly unmasked tokens is an unbiased estimate of that of intermediate diffusion states, and (ii) the probability of the full trajectory can be effectively estimated with a single forward pass of a re-masked final state. By integrating these two trajectory reduction strategies into a policy optimization objective, we propose Trajectory Reduction Policy Optimization (dTRPO). We evaluate dTRPO on 7B dLLMs across instruction-following and reasoning benchmarks. Results show that it substantially improves the core performance of state-of-the-art dLLMs, achieving gains of up to 9.6% on STEM tasks, up to 4.3% on coding tasks, and up to 3.0% on instruction-following tasks. Moreover, dTRPO exhibits strong training efficiency due to its offline, single-forward nature, and achieves improved generation efficiency through high-quality outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出dTRPO（轨迹约简策略优化）方法，通过两种轨迹约简策略降低扩散大语言模型的策略优化计算成本，实现在7B模型上的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）作为新型语言生成范式，其与人类偏好对齐面临独特挑战。离线策略训练的计算成本主要源于轨迹概率计算，阻碍了规模化训练的实现。
AI.method: （1）证明在参考策略正则化下，新解mask token的概率比是中间扩散态概率比的无偏估计；（2）证明可通过重mask最终态的单次前向传播有效估计完整轨迹概率。将这两种轨迹约简策略整合到策略优化目标中，形成dTRPO方法。
AI.result: 在7B dLLMs上的指令跟随和推理基准测试表明：STEM任务提升9.6%，代码任务提升4.3%，指令跟随任务提升3.0%。dTRPO具有离线、单次前向的高效训练特性，并因输出质量提升而具备更好的生成效率。
AI.conclusion: dTRPO通过轨迹约简策略显著降低了dLLM策略优化的计算成本，同时在多个任务类别上实现了实质性的性能提升，为扩散大语言模型的大规模离线训练提供了可行方案。

title: Data-efficient pre-training by scaling synthetic megadocs
summary: Synthetic data augmentation has emerged as a promising solution when pre-training is constrained by data rather than compute. We study how to design synthetic data algorithms that achieve better loss scaling: not only lowering loss at finite compute but especially as compute approaches infinity. We first show that pre-training on web data mixed with synthetically generated rephrases improves i.i.d. validation loss on the web data, despite the synthetic data coming from an entirely different distribution. With optimal mixing and epoching, loss and benchmark accuracy improve without overfitting as the number of synthetic generations grows, plateauing near $1.48\times$ data efficiency at 32 rephrases per document. We find even better loss scaling under a new perspective: synthetic generations from the same document can form a single substantially longer megadocument instead of many short documents. We show two ways to construct megadocs: stitching synthetic rephrases from the same web document or stretching a document by inserting rationales. Both methods improve i.i.d. loss, downstream benchmarks, and especially long-context loss relative to simple rephrasing, increasing data efficiency from $1.48\times$ to $1.80\times$ at $32$ generations per document. Importantly, the improvement of megadocs over simple rephrasing widens as more synthetic data is generated. Our results show how to design synthetic data algorithms that benefit more from increasing compute when data-constrained.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在"数据受限（而非算力受限）"的大模型预训练中，如何设计能持续改善损失缩放的合成数据算法。作者在 200M DCLM 真实 token、300M 参数过参数化模型、无限训练算力的设定下证明：混合简单改写（rephrasing）合成数据即可单调降低真实网页分布的 i.i.d. 验证损失（3.55→3.41，约 1.48× 数据效率）；进一步提出"megadoc"视角——同一文档的多次合成生成不应打散为独立短文档，而应拼接/拉伸成一篇超长文档（stitched rephrasing 与 latent thoughts），在 32 次生成/文档时把数据效率提升到 1.64× 与 1.80×，且 megadoc 相对简单改写的优势随生成数增加而扩大。
AI.motivation: 核心动机有两层：其一，算力增长快于可用网络文本，预训练日益受数据约束（数据效率预训练），而 Kim et al. (2025) 的形式化要求在"无限训练算力"下尽可能降低真实分布损失；其二，现有合成数据工作多聚焦于"把数据变成更高质量/更贴近下游任务的格式"（如改写、蒸馏、可验证域），很少有人研究合成数据能否用于建模**原始数据分布本身**，更少有人考察"随着合成数据量（生成次数）增加，损失是否持续缩放"这一渐近性质——这正是数据受限场景下最关键的问题（更多算力应带来更多收益，而非迅速饱和）。作者因此把问题表述为：设计损失缩放曲线更优的合成数据算法，即在固定生成算力预算 G 的极限下先达到无限训练算力的最优损失，再考察 G→∞ 时损失如何变化，并希望合成数据带来的收益能与 epoching、正则化、过参数化、集成等已有数据效率手段叠加。
AI.method:
设定与评测：沿用 Kim et al. (2025) 的数据效率形式化——200M token 的 DCLM 网页文本（164k 文档）、300M 参数（1.5B 用于消融）Llama 风格自回归 Transformer、4096 上下文、concat-and-chunk 数据流、跨文档注意力；合成生成器为外部 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct（temperature 1）。评测指标为**不含任何合成数据的真实网页验证集 i.i.d. loss**、由数据缩放律 L(D)=1.30/D^0.23+1.89 反解得到的"数据效率倍数"、长上下文损失（CS arXiv 论文、GitHub Python、英文 Wikipedia）以及 PIQA/SciQ/ARC-Easy 平均准确率；所有超参（学习率、weight decay、真实数据 epoch 数、混合比例）用"局部最优"网格搜索（凸性认证）确定，长上下文损失与基准因此是真正留出的评测。

三种算法：(1) Simple rephrasing——按 Maini et al. (2024) 提示把每篇真实文档改写成维基百科风格文章（平均 708 token），G 次生成后与真实流按混合比例混训，合成流无限 epoch；(2) Stitched rephrasing（受 ICPT 启发）——把同一真实文档的 G 个改写（加 EOS）拼接成一篇 megadoc，真实文档置于末尾优于置于开头（推测与 epiplexity/学习"由粗到细"的逆任务有关），拼接本身零成本，无需嵌入检索；(3) Latent Thoughts（受 Ruan et al. 2025 启发）——把文档切成 G+1 段，让生成器为每个切分点生成"由前缀推导后缀"的 rationale，并以 <think></think> 包裹插回，把文档"拉伸"为 megadoc（平均 thought 424 token）。另外检验：混合真实流的必要性、跨文档掩码消融、megadoc 收益来源（控制训练步数对比）、与集成（logits 平均）的可叠加性，以及自蒸馏的对比。
AI.result: ① 简单改写即使来自完全不同的分布也能改善 i.i.d. loss：G=32 时损失由 3.55 降到 3.41（改善 0.14），数据效率 1.48×，基准平均准确率 +5%，但约 32 次生成后明显饱和。② 两种 megadoc 均优于简单改写：stitched rephrasing 与 latent thoughts 在 32 次生成时数据效率分别为 1.64× 与 1.80×，基准提升 +6% 与 +9%；相对简单改写的损失优势从 G=4 的 0.02 扩大到 G=32 的 0.07，且饱和迹象更弱。③ 长上下文收益更大：G=32 时 arXiv CS 损失改善 0.14/0.19，对比简单改写在 GitHub Python 上再降 0.24、Wikipedia 降 0.08；在短文档（<600 token）切分集上 megadoc 同样缩放更好，说明收益是通用迁移而非仅长上下文。④ 机制分析：megadoc 的优势主要来自最优超参允许更长的训练（真实数据 epoch 16→32、混合比例 0.75→0.9，训练步数可达 5× 且不过拟合）；用简单改写的最优超参控制训练步数后，megadoc 的优势退化为随 G 基本不变的常数改善。⑤ 拼接中"真实文档放最后"最优；把真实文档也放入合成流始终有益；stitched rephrasing 约 70% 的收益来自真实流混合。⑥ 可叠加性：改写与两种 megadoc 都能降低集成渐近损失（相对真实数据集成渐近值至少再降 0.12），而自蒸馏不能（自蒸馏集成渐近 3.32 vs 标准 3.31），支持其收益与集成/蒸馏在性质上不同。⑦ 学生规模消融：1.5B 学生上三种方法的 loss win 均更大（0.212/0.248/0.274 vs 0.144/0.180/0.211），说明收益并非"生成器远强于学生"的伪影。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论是：合成数据不仅可以提升数据质量，还可以直接改善对原始网络分布的建模，其缩放行为可通过算法设计系统性优化。关键设计原则有三条——(a) 同一文档的多次合成生成应组成单一长文档（megadoc）而非被独立打散，这既提升 i.i.d. loss，也显著提升长上下文能力，且优势随生成数增加而扩大；(b) 合成数据必须与真实数据流混合训练，才能把长上下文/跨文档能力蒸馏回 i.i.d. 损失；(c) 合成数据与 epoching、正则化、过参数化、集成等已有数据效率手段可叠加，而自蒸馏不可。作者也给出边界与展望：实验使用外部更强生成器（Llama 3.1 8B Instruct）以规避从头预训练生成器的成本，因此尚未直接验证"自改进"设定；但结合 1.5B 学生缩放、Kotha et al. (2025) 的自改进实证与视觉领域数据增强的普遍性证据，作者认为在数据/算力充足时结论可能更强。megadoc 仍有较大设计空间（如提示策略、生成复杂度层级、真实文档在上下文窗口中的位置），且本文实验均在 200M token 规模、依赖 Kim et al. (2025) 的缩放律外推，更大规模从零验证留作未来工作；全部运行记录与代码已开源。

title: Can LLM generate interesting mathematical research problems?
summary: This paper is the second one in a series of work on the mathematical creativity of LLM. In the first paper, the authors proposed three criteria for evaluating the mathematical creativity of LLM and constructed a benchmark dataset to measure it. This paper further explores the mathematical creativity of LLM, with a focus on investigating whether LLM can generate valuable and cutting-edge mathematical research problems. We develop an agent to generate unknown problems and produced 665 research problems in differential geometry. Through human verification, we find that many of these mathematical problems are unknown to experts and possess unique research value.

AI.tldr: 本文是关于LLM数学创造力的系列研究第二篇，探讨LLM是否能生成有价值的尖端数学研究问题。作者开发了一个智能体生成了665个微分几何问题，经专家验证发现许多问题对专家来说是未知的且具有独特研究价值。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在解决第一篇论文中提出的评估标准问题，进一步探索大语言模型在数学研究领域的创造力，特别是生成未知且有价值的数学研究问题的能力。
AI.method: 开发了一个智能体（agent）用于生成未知数学问题，生成了665个微分几何领域的研究问题，并通过人工验证评估这些问题的原创性和研究价值。
AI.result: 经专家验证发现，生成的665个微分几何问题中，许多数学问题是专家此前未知的，并具有独特的研究价值。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备生成具有原创性和研究价值的尖端数学研究问题的能力，这为AI辅助数学研究提供了新的可能性。

title: Beyond Passive Aggregation: Active Auditing and Topology-Aware Defense in Decentralized Federated Learning
summary: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) remains highly vulnerable to adaptive backdoor attacks designed to bypass traditional passive defense metrics. To address this limitation, we shift the defensive paradigm toward a novel active, interventional auditing framework. First, we establish a dynamical model to characterize the spatiotemporal diffusion of adversarial updates across complex graph topologies. Second, we introduce a suite of proactive auditing metrics, stochastic entropy anomaly, randomized smoothing Kullback-Leibler divergence, and activation kurtosis. These metrics utilize private probes to stress-test local models, effectively exposing latent backdoors that remain invisible to conventional static detection. Furthermore, we implement a topology-aware defense placement strategy to maximize global aggregation resilience. We provide theoretical property for the system's convergence under co-evolving attack and defense dynamics. Numeric empirical evaluations across diverse architectures demonstrate that our active framework is highly competitive with state-of-the-art defenses in mitigating stealthy, adaptive backdoors while preserving primary task utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对去中心化联邦学习(DFL)中自适应后门攻击的主动干预审计框架，通过建立对抗性更新的时空扩散动态模型，引入随机熵异常、随机平滑KL散度、激活峰度等主动审计指标，并设计拓扑感知的防御部署策略，在保证主任务效用的同时有效缓解隐蔽的自适应后门攻击。
AI.motivation: 传统的被动防御指标无法有效检测DFL中隐蔽的自适应后门攻击，需要转向一种新颖的主动干预审计范式来解决这一局限性。
AI.method: 1) 建立对抗性更新在复杂图拓扑上时空扩散的动态模型；2) 引入一套主动审计指标：随机熵异常、随机平滑Kullback-Leibler散度、激活峰度，利用私有探针对本地模型进行压力测试；3) 实现拓扑感知的防御部署策略以最大化全局聚合弹性；4) 提供攻击与防御共同演化动力学下系统收敛的理论分析。
AI.result: 在多样化架构上的数值实证评估表明，该主动框架在缓解隐蔽自适应后门攻击方面具有高度竞争力，同时保留了主要任务效用。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的主动干预审计框架为DFL中的后门防御提供了一种有效的新范式，理论上证明了系统收敛性，实证上验证了防御效果。

title: ProRL Agent: Rollout-as-a-Service for RL Training of Multi-Turn LLM Agents
summary: Multi-turn LLM agents are increasingly important for solving complex, interactive tasks, and reinforcement learning (RL) is a key ingredient for improving their long-horizon behavior. However, RL training requires generating large numbers of sandboxed rollout trajectories, and existing infrastructures often couple rollout orchestration with the training loop, making systems hard to migrate and maintain. Under the rollout-as-a-service philosophy, we present ProRL Agent , a scalable infrastructure that serves the full agentic rollout lifecycle through an API service. ProRL Agent also provides standardized and extensible sandbox environments that support diverse agentic tasks in rootless HPC settings. We validate ProRL Agent through RL training on software engineering, math, STEM, and coding tasks. ProRL Agent is open-sourced and integrated as part of NVIDIA NeMo Gym.

AI.tldr: ProRL Agent是一个可扩展的基础设施，采用"rollout-as-a-service"理念，通过API服务提供完整的智能体 rollout 生命周期支持，并提供标准化、可扩展的沙箱环境以支持 rootless HPC 环境下的多样化智能体任务。
AI.motivation: 现有 RL 训练基础设施将 rollout 编排与训练循环紧密耦合，导致系统难以迁移和维护。同时，多轮 LLM 智能体在解决复杂交互任务方面越来越重要，但 RL 训练需要生成大量沙箱 rollout 轨迹。
AI.method: 提出 ProRL Agent 架构，采用 rollout-as-a-service 哲学，通过 API 服务形式提供智能体 rollout 生命周期支持；提供标准化且可扩展的沙箱环境，支持 rootless HPC 设置下的多样化智能体任务。
AI.result: 在软件工程、数学、STEM 和编码任务上验证了 ProRL Agent 的有效性，成功完成 RL 训练。
AI.conclusion: ProRL Agent 已开源并集成到 NVIDIA NeMo Gym 中，为多轮 LLM 智能体的 RL 训练提供了可扩展、易维护的基础设施解决方案。

title: GAPSL: A Gradient-Aligned Parallel Split Learning on Heterogeneous Data
summary: The increasing complexity of neural networks poses significant challenges for democratizing FL on resource?constrained client devices. Parallel split learning (PSL) has emerged as a promising solution by offloading substantial computing workload to a server via model partitioning, shrinking client-side computing load, and eliminating the client-side model aggregation for reduced communication and deployment costs. Since PSL is aggregation-free, it suffers from severe training divergence stemming from gradient directional inconsistency across clients. To address this challenge, we propose GAPSL, a gradient-aligned PSL framework that comprises two key components: leader gradient identification (LGI) and gradient direction alignment (GDA). LGI dynamically selects a set of directionally consistent client gradients to construct a leader gradient that captures the global convergence trend. GDA employs a direction-aware regularization to align each client's gradient with the leader gradient, thereby mitigating inter-device gradient directional inconsistency and enhancing model convergence. We evaluate GAPSL on a prototype computing testbed. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GAPSL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks in training accuracy and latency.

AI.tldr: GAPSL 是一种面向异构数据边云场景的"梯度对齐并行分割学习"框架。针对免聚合 PSL 在 non-IID 数据下因客户端梯度方向不一致而训练发散、收敛失败的核心问题，论文提出两个协同模块：LGI（Leader Gradient Identification，leader 梯度识别）动态筛选方向一致的客户端梯度子集并构造 leader 梯度，作为全局收敛方向的稳健代理；GDA（Gradient Direction Alignment，梯度方向对齐）基于自适应角度阈值过滤严重背离的梯度，并以余弦型方向感知正则项将各客户端梯度拉向 leader 梯度。两者全部在服务器端执行，不增加任何客户端—服务器通信或客户端计算开销。基于 Jetson 原型测试床的实验表明，GAPSL 在训练精度、收敛轮数与异构鲁棒性上均优于 SFL、EPSL、Vanilla SL 与 PSL。
AI.motivation: 神经网络的规模增长使资源受限的边缘设备难以独立承担联邦学习（FL）的训练与部署开销。并行分割学习（PSL）通过模型切分将重计算卸载到服务器，并彻底取消客户端侧模型聚合，从而降低通信与部署成本；但正因缺少聚合这一"统计校准机制"，在 non-IID 数据下各设备基于本地偏斜数据独立前向/反向传播，产生语义不一致且统计有偏的激活与服务端梯度，导致梯度方向不一致（gradient directional inconsistency），部分设备梯度甚至与全局下降方向冲突，最终造成精度显著下降甚至收敛失败。论文通过实证研究验证：PSL 的平均成对角度偏差显著大于 SFL，且与精度呈强负相关；单设备梯度实验也显示不同设备对收敛的贡献差异巨大，说明"等权处理所有客户端更新"并不最优。因此需要一种无需客户端聚合、能刻画全局收敛趋势的方向性参考与协调机制。
AI.method:
框架整体流程：全局模型切分为客户端子模型与服务器子模型；每轮各设备用本地数据做 FP 并上传激活；服务器执行 LGI 与 GDA，随后在服务器子模型上做 BP 生成激活梯度并回传；各设备用回传梯度在客户端子模型上做 BP 更新。

（1）LGI 三个步骤：①梯度一致性打分——以客户端 i 的服务端梯度与其他所有设备梯度的平均成对角度偏差 θ_i^t 作为一致性分数（越小越一致），该指标优于传统的梯度幅值度量；②自适应梯度选择——按一致性分数升序排序，引入时变选择比例 K^t = K_min + (t/T)·(ν_max^t − ν(θ^t))/(ν_max^t − ν_min^t)·(K_max − K_min)，其中 ν 为一致性分数的标准差（方向离散度），K_min=20%、K_max=80%；分数离散度高时收紧选择、方向趋于一致时放宽，并随训练进程 t/T 线性扩展，兼顾方向一致性与信息多样性；③leader 梯度构造——对选中的 top-K^t% 设备梯度取平均得到 g_lead^t。

（2）GDA 三个步骤：①角度偏差计算——计算各设备梯度与 leader 梯度的夹角 θ_lead,i^t；②自适应角度阈值——采用基于当前轮分布的一、二阶统计量构造稳健置信边界 θ_th^t = max(min(μ(θ_lead^t) − η·ν(θ_lead^t), π/2), 0)，避免历史 min-max 归一化对离群点的敏感性，上限 π/2 排除方向相反的更新；③方向感知正则化——对通过阈值的设备加入 λ(1 − cos θ_lead,i^t) 的非线性几何正则项，该项取值于 [0,1]、可微、且在接近对齐时梯度消失，从而不损害原更新；全局损失为各被选中设备正则化损失之和。

复杂度与实现：服务器端时间复杂度 O(|S|²d)（主要来自 LGI 两两角度计算）+ 排序 O(|S| log|S|)，GDA 为 O(|S|d)，缓存空间 O(|S|d)；计算仅为向量点积，相比主反向传播开销可忽略。原型采用微服务架构，服务器为 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX，边缘设备为 Jetson Nano，HTTP/2 + Protocol Buffers 传输，Python 3.7 + PyTorch 1.9.1；数据集 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100，模型 VGG-16（前 4 个卷积层在客户端）与 ViT-Base（前 3 个 transformer block 在客户端）；IID 均匀划分与 Dirichlet 划分（默认 α=0.1）；默认 10 台设备，λ 为 5e-4（VGG-16）/3e-5（ViT-Base），VGG-16 用 SGD(momentum 0.9，客户端 lr 0.005、服务器 lr 0.01，batch 128)，ViT-Base 用 AdamW（客户端 lr 1e-4、服务器 lr 3e-4，batch 64），基线共享超参。对比基线：Vanilla SL（顺序轮训）、SFL（参数服务器聚合）、PSL（无聚合）、EPSL（固定切层+末层部分梯度聚合）。
AI.result: 精度（CIFAR-10/VGG-16 与 CIFAR-100/ViT-Base，non-IID）：GAPSL 63.3% / 57.0%，SFL 60.7% / 53.4%，EPSL 59.4% / 51.4%，Vanilla SL 57.3% / 50.3%，PSL 47.3% / 43.2%；IID 下 GAPSL 亦最高（86.9% / 72.1%）。non-IID 下相对 SFL/EPSL/Vanilla SL/PSL 分别领先 2.6%/3.9%/6.0%/16.0%（CIFAR-10）与 3.6%/5.6%/6.7%/13.8%（CIFAR-100）。收敛轮数：GAPSL 32 轮（non-IID, CIFAR-10）vs SFL 42、EPSL 43、Vanilla SL 46、PSL 56；CIFAR-100/ViT-Base 为 290 轮 vs 361/366/369/401。扩展性：设备数从 10 增至 40 时，GAPSL non-IID 精度仅由 63.3% 降至 61.7%，而 PSL 由 47.3% 跌至 35.6%，SFL 由 60.7% 降至 55.9%，显示对设备规模与数据异构的强鲁棒性；异构程度加剧（α 由 0.9 降至 0.3）时 GAPSL 仍有 69.3%（CIFAR-10）/60.6%（CIFAR-100），而 PSL 降至 53.5%/41.2%。消融：LGI 优于 Non-LGI（不过滤全部梯度）与 Rand-LGI（随机选择），且在 ViT-Base 上优势更明显，说明深层 Transformer 对梯度不一致更敏感；GDA 优于 Non-GDA（仅用 leader 梯度更新）与 Rand-GDA（随机对齐），验证自适应阈值过滤与方向感知正则的必要性。此外 IID 场景下 GAPSL 略优于理论等价于集中式 mini-batch SGD 的 Vanilla SL，作者归因于 GDA 正则项对本地 mini-batch 采样噪声的平滑作用。
AI.conclusion: GAPSL 通过"识别方向性一致的参考梯度 + 以几何正则强制各设备梯度对齐"的两步机制，在不引入客户端侧模型聚合、不增加任何额外通信与客户端计算的前提下，解决了 aggregation-free PSL 在高度异构数据下的梯度方向冲突与收敛失败问题，在精度、收敛速度与系统鲁棒性上全面超越 SFL、EPSL、Vanilla SL 与 PSL，并具备良好的设备规模与异构程度可扩展性。其核心启示是：在无聚合的分割学习范式中，服务器侧已天然掌握反映客户端异质性的梯度信息，可据此在服务器内部完成跨设备的统计校准，从而以极低代价替代传统的模型聚合校准。

title: RewardFlow: Topology-Aware Reward Propagation on State Graphs for Agentic RL with Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) holds significant promise for enhancing the agentic reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) with external environments. However, the inherent sparsity of terminal rewards hinders fine-grained, state-level optimization. Although process reward modeling offers a promising alternative, training dedicated reward models often entails substantial computational costs and scaling difficulties. To address these challenges, we introduce RewardFlow, a lightweight method for estimating state-level rewards tailored to agentic reasoning tasks. RewardFlow leverages the intrinsic topological structure of states within reasoning trajectories by constructing state graphs. This enables an analysis of state-wise contributions to success, followed by topology-aware graph propagation to quantify contributions and yield objective, state-level rewards. When integrated as dense rewards for RL optimization, RewardFlow substantially outperforms prior RL baselines across four agentic reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance, robustness, and training efficiency. The implementation of RewardFlow is publicly available at https://github.com/tmlr-group/RewardFlow.

AI.tldr: RewardFlow是一种轻量级方法，通过构建状态图利用推理轨迹的拓扑结构，估计状态级奖励以增强LLM的智能体推理能力，解决了稀疏奖励和训练奖励模型成本高的问题。
AI.motivation: 强化学习(RL)在增强大型语言模型(LLM)的智能体推理能力方面具有潜力，但终端奖励的稀疏性阻碍了细粒度的状态级优化。虽然过程奖励建模是可行的替代方案，但训练专用奖励模型通常需要大量计算成本和扩展难度。
AI.method: RewardFlow利用推理轨迹中状态的内在拓扑结构，通过构建状态图进行分析，量化各状态对成功的贡献度，然后进行拓扑感知的图传播以生成客观的状态级奖励。
AI.result: RewardFlow作为密集奖励集成到RL优化中后，在四个智能体推理基准测试中显著优于 prior RL基线，表现出更优的性能、鲁棒性和训练效率。
AI.conclusion: RewardFlow提供了一种轻量级、高效的状态级奖励估计方法，能够在不训练专用奖励模型的情况下实现细粒度的智能体推理优化，为LLM智能体训练提供了新的有效途径。

title: HEP Statistical Inference for UAV Fault Detection: CLs, LRT, and SBI Applied to Blade Damage
summary: This paper transfers three statistical methods from particle physics to multirotor propeller fault detection: the likelihood ratio test (LRT) for binary detection, the CLs modified frequentist method for false alarm rate control, and sequential neural posterior estimation (SNPE) for quantitative fault characterization. Operating on spectral features tied to rotor harmonic physics, the system returns three outputs: binary detection, controlled false alarm rates, and calibrated posteriors over fault severity and motor location. On UAV-FD, a hexarotor dataset of 18 real flights with 5% and 10% blade damage, leave-one-flight-out cross-validation gives AUC 0.862 +/- 0.007 (95% CI: 0.849--0.876), outperforming CUSUM (0.708 +/- 0.010), autoencoder (0.753 +/- 0.009), and LSTM autoencoder (0.551). At 5% false alarm rate the system detects 93% of significant and 81% of subtle blade damage. On PADRE, a quadrotor platform, AUC reaches 0.986 after refitting only the generative models. SNPE gives a full posterior over fault severity (90% credible interval coverage 92--100%, MAE 0.012), so the output includes uncertainty rather than just a point estimate or fault flag. Per-flight sequential detection achieves 100% fault detection with 94% overall accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文将粒子物理中的三种统计方法（似然比检验LRT、CLs频率方法、序贯神经后验估计SNPE）应用于多旋翼无人机螺旋桨故障检测，在UAV-FD和PADRE数据集上实现了高准确率的故障检测、定量的故障严重程度估计以及可控的误报率。
AI.motivation: 多旋翼无人机的螺旋桨故障可能带来严重安全风险，现有的故障检测方法（如CUSUM、自编码器、LSTM自编码器）在检测性能和准确性上存在不足，且缺乏对故障严重程度的定量评估能力，因此需要引入更先进的统计方法来提升检测效果。
AI.method: 本文采用三种基于频谱特征的统计方法：1）似然比检验（LRT）用于二值故障检测；2）CLs修正频率方法用于误报率控制；3）序贯神经后验估计（SNPE）用于定量故障表征，包括故障严重程度和电机位置的后验分布。在UAV-FD数据集上使用留一飞行交叉验证评估，在PADRE数据集上仅重新拟合生成模型。
AI.result: 在UAV-FD数据集上，AUC达到0.862±0.007（95%CI: 0.849-0.876），优于CUSUM(0.708)、自编码器(0.753)和LSTM自编码器(0.551)。在5%误报率下，检测到93%的显著故障和81%的轻微螺旋桨损伤。在PADRE数据集上，AUC达到0.986。SNPE给出的90%可信区间覆盖率为92-100%，MAE为0.012。每飞行序贯检测实现100%故障检测和94%总体准确率。
AI.conclusion: 从粒子物理转移的统计方法在多旋翼无人机螺旋桨故障检测中表现出色，CLs方法有效控制了误报率，SNPE提供了带有不确定性的完整后验分布而非点估计，证明了跨领域方法转移的可行性和优越性。

title: Conflict-Based Search for Multi Agent Path Finding with Asynchronous Actions
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) seeks collision-free paths for multiple agents from their respective start locations to their respective goal locations while minimizing path costs. Most existing MAPF algorithms rely on a common assumption of synchronized actions, where the actions of all agents start at the same time and always take a time unit, which may limit the use of MAPF planners in practice. To get rid of this assumption, Continuous-time Conflict-Based Search (CCBS) is a popular approach that can find optimal solutions for MAPF with asynchronous actions (MAPF-AA). However, CCBS has recently been identified to be incomplete due to an uncountably infinite state space created by continuous wait durations. This paper proposes a new method, Conflict-Based Search with Asynchronous Actions (CBS-AA), which bypasses this theoretical issue and can solve MAPF-AA with completeness and solution optimality guarantees. Based on CBS-AA, we also develop conflict resolution techniques to improve the scalability of CBS-AA further. Our test results show that our method can reduce the number of branches by up to 90%.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多智能体路径规划(MAPF)中的异步动作问题，提出了一种新的CBS-AA算法，解决了现有CCBS算法因连续等待时间导致的状态空间无限性而不完整的问题，并在保持完整性和最优性保证的同时，通过冲突解决技术将分支数量减少高达90%。
AI.motivation: 现有MAPF算法大多假设同步动作(所有智能体的动作同时开始且耗时一个时间单元)，这限制了MAPF规划器在实践中的应用。虽然CCBS可以处理异步动作的MAPF(MAPF-AA)，但由于连续等待时间导致的不可数无限状态空间，CCBS已被证明是不完整的。
AI.method: 提出Conflict-Based Search with Asynchronous Actions (CBS-AA)方法，绕过CCBS的理论问题。基于CBS-AA开发了冲突解决技术以进一步提高可扩展性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法可以将分支数量减少高达90%。
AI.conclusion: CBS-AA能够解决MAPF-AA问题，具有完整性和解最优性保证，冲突解决技术显著提高了算法的可扩展性。

title: SINDy-KANs: Sparse identification of non-linear dynamics through Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs) have arisen as a potential way to enhance the interpretability of machine learning. However, solutions learned by KANs are not necessarily interpretable, in the sense of being sparse or parsimonious. Sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) is a complementary approach that allows for learning sparse equations for dynamical systems from data; however, learned equations are limited by the library. In this work, we present SINDy-KANs, which simultaneously train a KAN and a SINDy-like representation to increase interpretability of KAN representations with SINDy applied at the level of each activation function, while maintaining the function compositions possible through deep KANs. We apply our method to a number of symbolic regression tasks, including dynamical systems, to show accurate equation discovery across a range of systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SINDy-KANs：在 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络的每个激活函数层级联 SINDy 式稀疏回归，通过影子矩阵 Λ 与 L1 正则直接强制稀疏、可读的符号表达式，同时保留深层 KAN 的函数复合能力；在符号回归、线性 ODE、阻尼摆、ABC 流、Lorenz、Kuramoto 等任务上准确恢复方程，并可扩展到带噪数据与直接学习系数版本（direct SINDy-KANs）。
AI.motivation: Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）以可训练激活函数替代固定激活+可训练权重，被寄予提升机器学习可解释性的期望，但已有工作表明 KAN 学到的解并不必然稀疏、简约，符号回归所得方程往往复杂；而稀疏辨识非线性动力学（SINDy）可从数据中学习稀疏方程，却受限于用户预先指定的候选函数库（library），难以表达函数复合等复杂结构。作者的目标是让 KAN 的每个激活函数本身强制为一个稀疏符号表达式（而非事后用库匹配或剪枝），从而在保留深层 KAN 函数复合能力的同时得到简约、可读的方程。
AI.method: 1) 架构：L 层 KAN，激活函数 φ_{ℓ,j,i} 由 B 样条（k=5）+ 基函数 b(x)=x/(1+e^{-x}) 的加权组合参数化；引入乘法节点（每层指定 n_j^M 个节点把输入激活相乘），使单隐层即可表示二次项。2) 稀疏层：在每个激活函数处构造一元候选函数库 Θ_{ℓ,i}(X_i^{(ℓ)})（如 1、x、x²、x³、sin、cos，可按层指定不同库），通过稀疏回归（最小二乘+稀疏化）求解 ξ_{ℓ,j,i}，使 φ_{ℓ,j,i}=Θ·ξ。3) 损失函数：L = λ_KAN·L_KAN + λ_S·L_S + λ_Λ·L_Λ + λ_1‖Λ‖_1 + λ_2‖Λ−Ξ_S‖²，其中 Λ 为影子矩阵表示稀疏化的 Ξ_S，L_Λ 为用 Λ 替换系数后的网络重构误差，L1 正则直接驱动稀疏性。4) 变体 direct SINDy-KANs：不训练底层 KAN，直接用 ADAM 学习 ξ（等价于 S2KAN，训练约快 33%），但稳健性较差。5) 实现基于 jaxKAN（B 样条实现），与 pykan 符号回归对比，后处理用 sympy；噪声场景先训“forward KAN”再用 JAX 自动微分求导。
AI.result: 符号回归 f(x,y)=cos(x²+y) 被精确恢复为 0.9999cos(1.0000x²+0.9999y)，而 pykan 漏掉 x² 项；L1 损失呈现两个平台（3+π/2 与 3），对应 sin(x²+y+π/2) 到 cos(x²+y) 的稀疏化过程。3D 线性 ODE 系数恢复误差 <1%；阻尼摆一层/两层分别得 dx/dt≈y、dy/dt≈−9.79sin(x)−0.05y（两层多出 −0.0185x 项）；ABC 流直接学出频率（如 0.7849 与真值 π/4=0.7854 一致），优于需预设频率的标准 SINDy；Lorenz 系统通过 2 个乘法节点精确恢复 x(28−z)、xy 等耦合项（系数精度达 1e-5）；Kuramoto 系统恢复 ω=(15.9995, 5.0002, 11.0003) 与耦合系数≈1，且仅用 6 个隐层节点中的 3 个以最小化 L1 惩罚。噪声实验显示相对噪声约 30% 以内仍稳健，但高噪声下会误学高阶项（如 y³、z³）。direct SINDy-KANs 与主方法精度相当但训练更快、收敛更困难。
AI.conclusion: SINDy-KANs 通过在每个 KAN 激活函数层面施加 SINDy 式稀疏辨识，能可靠地从数据中发现简约、可读的符号方程，并支持标准 SINDy 难以表示的函数复合，兼顾了 KAN 的深度表达力与 SINDy 的稀疏可解释性，为可解释/可信的科学机器学习提供了一套有原则的框架。局限包括：输入变量增多时可解释性下降；动力学方程发现依赖数值微分、对噪声敏感（30% 以上噪声会出现虚假高阶项）；所需网络深度事先难确定（可考虑多出口 KAN 自选架构）；未来可与域分解、自适应网格、优化器等 KAN 训练方案结合，并探索部分激活保留 B 样条、部分固定的混合形式。

title: Bridging Network Fragmentation: A Semantic-Augmented DRL Framework for UAV-aided VANETs
comment: 13 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Cognitive Communications and Networking
summary: Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs) are the digital cornerstone of autonomous driving, yet they suffer from severe network fragmentation in urban environments due to physical obstructions. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), with their high mobility, have emerged as a vital solution to bridge these connectivity gaps. However, traditional Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based UAV deployment strategies lack semantic understanding of road topology, often resulting in blind exploration and sample inefficiency. By contrast, Large Language Models (LLMs) possess powerful reasoning capabilities capable of identifying topological importance, though applying them to control tasks remains challenging. To address this, we propose the Semantic-Augmented DRL (SA-DRL) framework. Firstly, we propose a fragmentation quantification method based on Road Topology Graphs (RTG) and Dual Connected Graphs (DCG). Subsequently, we design a four-stage pipeline to transform a general-purpose LLM into a domain-specific topology expert. Finally, we propose the Semantic-Augmented PPO (SA-PPO) algorithm, which employs a Logit Fusion mechanism to inject the LLM's semantic reasoning directly into the policy as a prior, effectively guiding the agent toward critical intersections. Extensive high-fidelity simulations demonstrate that SA-PPO achieves state-of-the-art performance with remarkable efficiency, reaching baseline performance levels using only 26.6% of the training episodes. Ultimately, SA-PPO improves two key connectivity metrics by 13.2% and 23.5% over competing methods, while reducing energy consumption to just 28.2% of the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文针对城市 VANET 因建筑遮挡导致的网络碎裂问题，提出语义增强深度强化学习框架 SA-DRL：先用「路网拓扑图 RTG + 对偶连通图 DCG」严格量化碎裂程度并把 UAV 中继问题化为动态双图连通性最大化问题；再用四阶段流水线（轻量 PPO 探索采集状态 → 构造即时奖励动作分数监督 → LoRA 对齐轻量 LLM 成为拓扑专家 → 语义先验经 Logit Fusion 注入 PPO）实现 SA-PPO。在深圳 47 节点/88 边真实轨迹仿真中，SA-PPO 仅用 Vanilla PPO 28.6% 的训练回合即达到其最终收敛奖励，连通分量内车辆数与分量规模分别提升 7.9% 与 8.7%，UAV 能耗下降 21.3%，在六个未见交通时段与济南另一拓扑上均保持良好泛化。
AI.motivation: 城市 VANET 依靠 V2V/V2I 支撑协同感知、交通预警与计算卸载，但建筑物造成的阴影衰落与车辆高速移动使网络不断被切分为孤立方簇，RSU 骨干受建设成本与选址限制无法覆盖盲区。UAV 可作为空中移动中继，但其部署规划是含能量约束的高维非凸动态优化问题；MILP/凸优化/势场法需要精确环境模型、难以求解，DRL 虽可交互学习，但现有探索与道路拓扑无关，必须靠试错"发现"关键交叉口，样本效率低、且对交通分布变化适应性差。LLM 具备拓扑重要性推理能力，但直接用于控制存在输出格式不可靠、无法给出完整动作空间先验等障碍。
AI.method: 1) 图论建模：将路网映射为 RTG（顶点权重表示覆盖状态 0/1/2，边权重为路段车辆数），定义 c-vertex/c-edge/c-graph，再通过对偶变换构造 DCG，使 VANET 的连通子网与 DCG 的连通分量一一对应，以 K(t)（碎片数）与 C(t)（碎片内平均车辆数）量化碎裂；通信采用概率性空地 A2G 模型（LoS 概率随仰角变化、LoS/NLoS 加权路径损耗），UAV 采用悬停-通信范式，能耗含推进/悬停/通信三项；优化目标为归一化连通性 1/K(t) 与归一化能耗的加权时序和。2) 四阶段 SA-DRL：Stage 1 用轻量 PPO 探索收集去重状态库；Stage 2 将状态序列化为整数语义文本（每路段车辆数=需覆盖的交通热点、节点权重=具备回传能力的交叉口），枚举全部动作计算即时奖励并离散化为 0–9 的动作分数监督；Stage 3 用 LoRA（冻结骨干、注入低秩矩阵，可合并回主干以支撑高频推理）对齐预训练 LLM；Stage 4 提出 SA-PPO：LLM 输出经标准化为 z_LLM，PPO MLP 输出 z_PPO，融合策略 π̃=softmax(z_PPO+λ·z_LLM) 同时用于采样与 PPO 优化，LLM 全程冻结，λ=0 退化为 Vanilla PPO。3) 高吞吐并行训练系统：N 个并行环境、批内去重、批量 LLM 推理、语义 logits 有界 LRU 缓存（上限 10 万条，状态确定→缓存复用不改变策略分布）。4) 评测：深圳/济南真实轨迹高保真仿真，基线含 SAC、Vanilla PPO、GAT-PPO；LLM 指标含 BLEU-4、ROUGE-L、JSON 解析成功率、Kendall's τ、Top-10 命中率。
AI.result: LLM 对齐方面：纯提示工程的 Qwen2.5-3B 输出 JSON 解析成功率为 0%、BLEU-4 仅 0.79，无法给出有效排序；LoRA 对齐后四个模型 JSON PSR 均达 100%，Gemma3-4B 的 Kendall's τ 最高（88.89%，HR10=58.60%），Qwen2.5-3B BLEU-4/ROUGE-L 最优（75.10/81.19，τ=86.14%）；但 Gemma3-4B 吞吐在约 9 steps/s 饱和（VRAM/KV-Cache 瓶颈），Qwen2.5-3B 在 batch=128 时达约 58 steps/s，故选其为骨干（batch=128）。任务层面：SA-PPO 约 1,200 回合即达到 Vanilla PPO 约 4,200 回合才有的收敛奖励（29.5），即仅用 28.6% 回合、交互量减少 71.4%；连通分量内车辆数 40.9 vs 37.9（+7.9%），分量规模 20.0 vs 18.4（+8.7%），能耗 11.1 kJ vs 14.1 kJ（-21.3%）；GAT-PPO 反而更差（36.4/17.3/16.1 kJ），SAC 近乎静止、连通性弱。消融显示：MLP-guided PPO 连通性最高（42.7）但能耗 13.4 kJ，优势 SFT 变体分量规模最大（20.9）但能耗 12.1 kJ，纯语义策略连通性优于 Vanilla PPO 但能耗最高 15.2 kJ，说明增益同时来自监督构造与先验模型本身且需 RL 纠偏；λ∈{0,0.25,0.5,1,2} 与衰减调度均稳健，λ=0.25 略优，λ=0 相比默认奖励降 7.19%、能耗升至 13.1 kJ；缓存使单次训练由约 2 小时降至约 7 分钟（跨实验共享后约 1.5 分钟）。跨时段测试中 SA-PPO 在 6 个时段中 5 个取得最优连通车辆数、全部取得最优分量规模，12:00 稀疏场景提升 17.7%/20.7%，16:00 密集场景能耗降低 27.3%；济南拓扑独立重训后仍显著更早进入高奖励区（Vanilla PPO 渐近奖励略高）。
AI.conclusion: SA-DRL 框架用 RTG/DCG 将 VANET 碎裂缓解形式化为动态双图连通性最大化问题，并通过 Logit Fusion 把对齐后 LLM 的拓扑相关动作先验作为可修正的先验嵌入 PPO，在不改动环境奖励、且先验全程在线生效的前提下兼顾了拓扑引导与长时序回报学习，显著提升样本效率与连通—能耗折中，并在时间分布漂移与跨城市拓扑上保持优势。局限与展望：论文声明结果主要体现决策框架可行性而非实时机载实现——边缘推理的通信/排队时延未建模，3B 骨干的机载内存与功耗受限，需量化、蒸馏与时延建模；UAV 仅能部署于交叉口（对稀疏交叉口或超长路段需插入虚拟候选节点）；交叉城市属"独立重训"而非零样本迁移；多 UAV 协同与更广泛迁移超出本文范围。需注意：摘要版（arXiv 首次提交版）报告的提升为 13.2%/23.5%、能耗降至基线 28.2%、仅需 26.6% 回合，与 arXiv 全文最新版本的 7.9%/8.7%、能耗降 21.3%、28.6% 回合不一致，两版结论差异应以全文最新版本为准。

title: Transformers Learn Robust In-Context Regression under Distributional Uncertainty
summary: Recent work has shown that Transformers can perform in-context learning for linear regression under restrictive assumptions, including i.i.d. data, Gaussian noise, and Gaussian regression coefficients. However, real-world data often violate these assumptions: the distributions of inputs, noise, and coefficients are typically unknown, non-Gaussian, and may exhibit dependency across the prompt. This raises a fundamental question: can Transformers learn effectively in-context under realistic distributional uncertainty? We study in-context learning for noisy linear regression under a broad range of distributional shifts, including non-Gaussian coefficients, heavy-tailed noise, and non-i.i.d. prompts. We compare Transformers against classical baselines that are optimal or suboptimal under the corresponding maximum-likelihood criteria. Across all settings, Transformers consistently match or outperform these baselines, demonstrating robust in-context adaptation beyond classical estimators.

AI.tldr: 研究Transformer在非理想分布条件下（Non-Gaussian系数、重尾噪声、非i.i.d.提示）的上下文学习能力，发现其性能可匹配或超越经典最大似然最优/次优基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明Transformer可在严格假设（i.i.d.数据、高斯噪声、高斯系数）下进行上下文学习，但现实数据通常违反这些假设，分布未知、非高斯且提示间可能存在依赖性，因此需要探究Transformer在真实分布不确定性下的有效性。
AI.method: 在广泛的分布偏移场景下研究带噪线性回归的上下文学习，包括非高斯系数、重尾噪声和非i.i.d.提示，并将Transformer与各对应最大似然准则下的最优或次优经典基线进行对比。
AI.result: 在所有设置中，Transformer始终能够匹配或超越这些基线方法，表现出稳健的上下文适应能力。
AI.conclusion: Transformer在上下文学习中展现出超越经典估计器的鲁棒性，为其在现实场景中的应用提供了理论支持。

title: Geography According to ChatGPT -- How Generative AI Represents and Reasons about Geography
summary: Understanding how AI will represent and reason about geography should be a key concern for all of us, as the broader public increasingly interacts with spaces and places through these systems. Similarly, in line with the nature of foundation models, our own research often relies on pre-trained models. Hence, understanding what world AI systems construct is as important as evaluating their accuracy, including factual recall. To motivate the need for such studies, we provide three illustrative vignettes, i.e., exploratory probes, in the hope that they will spark lively discussions and follow-up work: (1) Do models form strong defaults, and how brittle are model outputs to minute syntactic variations? (2) Can distributional shifts resurface from the composition of individually benign tasks, e.g., when using AI systems to create personas? (3) Do we overlook deeper questions of understanding when solely focusing on the ability of systems to recall facts such as geographic principles?

AI.tldr: 论文探讨了AI系统如何表示和推理地理知识的深层问题，强调理解AI构建的"世界模型"与评估其准确性同等重要。通过三个探索性案例研究来激发讨论：模型默认假设的稳定性、组合任务中的分布漂移、以及仅关注事实回忆而忽视深层理解的问题。
AI.motivation: 随着公众越来越多地通过AI系统与空间和地点互动，理解AI如何表示和推理地理信息成为关键问题。同时，由于研究依赖预训练模型，理解AI构建的"世界模型"与评估其准确性同等重要。
AI.method: 提出三个探索性案例研究（vignettes）作为分析框架：(1)通过微小句法变化测试模型默认假设的稳定性；(2)研究组合 benign 任务（如创建人物画像）时分布漂移是否重现；(3)反思仅评估事实回忆能力是否忽略更深层的理解问题。
AI.result: 作为立场/观点论文，未报告具体实验结果，而是提出三个开放性问题作为未来研究的方向，旨在激发学界讨论和后续工作。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁学界关注AI地理推理的深层问题，包括：模型对地理知识的默认假设与脆弱性、组合任务中的分布漂移风险、以及评估AI地理理解时不应仅关注事实回忆而应关注更深层的理解能力。

title: SpecForge: A Flexible and Efficient Open-Source Training Framework for Speculative Decoding
summary: Large language models incur high inference latency due to sequential autoregressive decoding. Speculative decoding alleviates this bottleneck by using a lightweight draft model to propose multiple tokens for batched verification. However, its adoption has been limited by the lack of high-quality draft models and scalable training infrastructure. We introduce SpecForge, an open-source, production-oriented framework for training speculative decoding models with full support for EAGLE-3. SpecForge incorporates target-draft decoupling, hybrid parallelism, optimized training kernels, and integration with production-grade inference engines, enabling up to 9.9x faster EAGLE-3 training for Qwen3-235B-A22B. In addition, we release SpecBundle, a suite of production-grade EAGLE-3 draft models trained with SpecForge for mainstream open-source LLMs. Through a systematic study of speculative decoding training recipes, SpecBundle addresses the scarcity of high-quality drafts in the community, and our draft models achieve up to 4.48x end-to-end inference speedup on SGLang, establishing SpecForge as a practical foundation for real-world speculative decoding deployment.

AI.tldr: SpecForge是一个开源的生产级框架，用于训练推测解码（speculative decoding）模型，支持EAGLE-3架构，可实现高达9.9倍的训练加速。同时发布SpecBundle套件，包含针对主流开源LLM训练的高质量EAGLE-3草案模型，在SGLang上实现最高4.48倍的端到端推理加速。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型由于顺序自回归解码导致高推理延迟，现有的推测解码方法缺乏高质量的draft模型和可扩展的训练基础设施，限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: 引入target-draft解耦、混合并行、优化训练内核，并与生产级推理引擎集成。使用SpecForge框架训练EAGLE-3模型。
AI.result: SpecForge为Qwen3-235B-A22B实现高达9.9倍的EAGLE-3训练加速；SpecBundle中的draft模型在SGLang上实现最高4.48倍的端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: SpecForge为现实世界的推测解码部署提供了实用的基础，解决了社区中高品质draft模型稀缺的问题。

title: Reasoning over mathematical objects: on-policy reward modeling and test time aggregation
summary: The ability to precisely derive mathematical objects is a core requirement for downstream STEM applications, including mathematics, physics, and chemistry, where reasoning must culminate in formally structured expressions. Yet, current LM evaluations of mathematical and scientific reasoning rely heavily on simplified answer formats such as numerical values or multiple choice options due to the convenience of automated assessment. In this paper we provide three contributions for improving reasoning over mathematical objects: (i) we build and release training data and benchmarks for deriving mathematical objects, the Principia suite; (ii) we provide training recipes with strong LLM-judges and verifiers, where we show that on-policy judge training boosts performance; (iii) we show how on-policy training can also be used to scale test-time compute via aggregation. We find that strong LMs such as Qwen3-235B and o3 struggle on Principia, while our training recipes can bring significant improvements over different LLM backbones, while simultaneously improving results on existing numerical and MCQA tasks, demonstrating cross-format generalization of reasoning abilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Principia套件，用于评估和改进语言模型对数学对象的推理能力。通过构建专门的训练数据和基准、训练LLM判断器和验证器，以及探索测试时计算扩展方法，解决现有评估过度简化的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前数学和科学推理评估依赖简化格式（数值或多选题），无法评估形式化结构化表达式的推理能力。STEM应用需要精确推导数学对象，但现有LM评估存在差距。
AI.method: 构建Principia训练数据和基准；开发基于强LLM判断器的训练配方，展示on-policy判断器训练的优势；探索通过聚合进行测试时计算扩展。
AI.result: Qwen3-235B和o3在Principia上表现困难；训练配方在不同LLM骨干上带来显著提升；同时改善现有数值和MCQA任务结果，展示推理能力的跨格式泛化。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法不仅在数学对象推导任务上取得进展，还展示了跨格式泛化能力，为STEM领域更真实的推理评估奠定了基础。

title: Attack by Unlearning: Unlearning-Induced Adversarial Attacks on Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used for learning from graph-structured data in domains such as social networks, recommender systems, and financial platforms. To comply with privacy regulations like the GDPR, CCPA, and PIPEDA, approximate graph unlearning, which aims to remove the influence of specific data points from trained models without full retraining, has become an increasingly important component of trustworthy graph learning. However, approximate unlearning often incurs subtle performance degradation, which may incur negative and unintended side effects. In this work, we show that such degradations can be amplified into adversarial attacks. We introduce the notion of \textbf{unlearning corruption attacks}, where an adversary injects carefully chosen nodes into the training graph and later requests their deletion. Because deletion requests are legally mandated and cannot be denied, this attack surface is both unavoidable and stealthy: the model performs normally during training, but accuracy collapses only after unlearning is applied. Technically, we formulate this attack as a bi-level optimization problem: to overcome the challenges of black-box unlearning and label scarcity, we approximate the unlearning process via gradient-based updates and employ a surrogate model to generate pseudo-labels for the optimization. Extensive experiments across benchmarks and unlearning algorithms demonstrate that small, carefully designed unlearning requests can induce significant accuracy degradation, raising urgent concerns about the robustness of GNN unlearning under real-world regulatory demands. The source code will be released upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统研究"遗忘腐化攻击"（unlearning corruption attacks）：攻击者先向训练图注入少量精心构造的节点（特征+连接边可控），随后以合法删除请求触发GNN的近似遗忘过程，使模型在遗忘后才发生精度崩塌。该攻击利用了GDPR/CCPA等法规强制的"被遗忘权"，因此模型拥有者难以拒绝，且在训练阶段完全隐形。方法上，作者将其形式化为双层优化问题：用一步梯度下降近似黑盒遗忘算子以获得可微梯度，用代理模型产生伪标签解决无标签节点问题，并通过sigmoid重参数化+末端硬投影优化离散边预算。实验表明，在Cora/Citeseer/Pubmed/Flickr上，配合GIF、CEU、GA三种遗忘算法，攻击可造成最高约59%的精度下降（Pubmed），而遗忘前精度几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络被广泛用于社交网络、推荐系统、金融网络等图结构数据场景，而GDPR、CCPA、PIPEDA等隐私法规要求模型在无需完全重训练的前提下移除特定训练数据的影响，这推动了"近似图遗忘"（approximate graph unlearning）的发展。然而近似遗忘本质上只是对完全重训练的逼近，必然带来细微但不可避免的性能退化。论文提出的核心研究问题是：能否通过精心设计遗忘请求本身，把这种不可避免的退化放大并武器化为对GNN的对抗攻击？其现实动机在于：节点创建与删除是合法的用户操作，删除请求受法律强制、模型拥有者难以拒绝（带来法律与声誉成本）；同时攻击高度隐蔽——注入节点在训练期几乎不损害精度，性能崩塌只在执行遗忘（模型往往已上线部署）后才显现。该范式不同于传统投毒/后门攻击：它不依赖推理期触发器，而是把被法规强制执行的遗忘流程本身当作触发机制。
AI.method: 威胁模型为黑盒、目标模型无关：攻击者只能获取原训练图（可通过公开API/爬虫获得）、可注入节点并修改其特征/边/标签，无权访问受害者模型架构、参数或输出，仅训练一个代理模型f̄模拟其学习与遗忘动态。攻击形式化为双层最大化问题（Def. 4.2）：目标项最大化遗忘注入节点后模型在无标签节点上的损失（G1）；约束项为注入边预算B≤B（G2，注入边过多会触发机器人/欺诈检测）；并约束对良性节点子集V₀执行遗忘时损失不超过δ（G3）。方法上分两步解决难点：(1) 黑盒遗忘近似——采用梯度上升式遗忘目标g_γ（在保留干净标注节点损失的同时以系数γ对被遗忘节点做梯度上升），并用一步梯度下降近似求解器θ_un = θ_inj − η_un·∇_θ g_γ，使整个遗忘过程全可微，可用自动微分（梯度套梯度）反传到注入特征与边；(2) 标签稀缺——在注入图上训练代理模型f̄，用其预测构造无标签节点的伪标签ȳ，构造代理攻击目标L_atk = L(删除注入节点后的损失) − λ·L(删除良性节点后的损失)，其中第二项为隐蔽性正则。离散边优化采用sigmoid重参数化在无约束空间累加梯度（避免PGD式逐步离散投影导致的梯度消失），最后做一次硬投影（由重排不等式证明逐行取top-B为最优欧氏投影）。可扩展性上利用GNN聚合的局部性，仅把注入边优化限制在目标节点的k跳邻域S_cand内，并固定节点间内部边Ã_intra=0；Flickr上采样10%测试节点及其1跳邻居作为候选集，复杂度从O(L(E+mn)d+(n+m)d²)降至O(L(E+m·n_sub)d+(n+m)d²)。实验设置：4个基准数据集、2层GCN受害者、注入节点数为图规模5%、每节点边预算B=5；遗忘算法为GIF、CEU、GA；对比基线包括NoAttack、Random、Copy、NewCopy、TestCopy、TestLink以及SBA、UGBA、TDGIA三种节点注入攻击；指标为Original Accuracy、Unlearned Accuracy与ΔAcc。
AI.result: 1) 攻击效果（G1）：OptimAttack在全部4个数据集×3种遗忘算法上取得最大ΔAcc，Pubmed上在GIF与CEU下造成约59%的精度崩塌（0.8351→0.2443、0.8102→0.2146），而Random/Copy等启发式基线的ΔAcc常接近0甚至为负；SBA/UGBA/TDGIA等标准投毒/后门注入攻击对遗忘过程不敏感，破坏有限（如GIF-Pubmed下UGBA 0.2390、TDGIA 0.0307）。2) 隐蔽性（G2）：遗忘前Original Accuracy与干净基线接近，如Citeseer+GIF下OptimAttack为0.7381对比NoAttack的0.7357，攻击在训练期不可察觉。3) 跨遗忘机制可迁移：尽管代理模型使用GA作为遗忘算子生成攻击，仍能有效破坏使用影响函数（GIF）与认证遗忘（CEU）的受害模型。4) 跨模型可迁移：使用GCN代理生成的攻击对SGC、GAT同样有效，GAT甚至更脆弱（Cora上降至接近随机）。5) 可扩展近似：Flickr上仅优化10%测试节点及1跳邻居，仍取得约14.6%的精度下降。6) 消融：去除隐蔽性正则（λ=0）后，良性节点遗忘引发大幅连带损害（Citeseer的Benign F1由0.7286降至0.6517，原始F1为0.7380），而加入正则后基本恢复原性能且攻击强度几乎不受损；预算消融显示在默认5%删除比例、B=5的极紧约束下攻击已接近最大破坏，继续放宽预算收益边际递减。所有实验重复5次并报告标准差。
AI.conclusion: 论文首次提出面向GNN的"遗忘腐化攻击"这一新攻击面，指出合规驱动的强制遗忘机制本身可被武器化，从而在合规与鲁棒性之间形成结构性张力。方法上提出能同时满足G1–G3三项目标的统一双层优化框架，通过一步梯度近似黑盒遗忘算子、代理模型伪标签解决标签稀缺，并以sigmoid重参数化与末端投影处理离散边约束，配合邻域限制策略获得一定可扩展性。实验证明该攻击可跨数据集、跨遗忘算法（GIF/CEU/GA）、跨受害者架构（GCN/SGC/GAT）稳定生效，且遗忘前不可检测，说明现有图遗忘方法在真实监管环境下的鲁棒性存在系统性隐患。作者明确指出本文首要贡献是确立该攻击面而非极致可扩展性，未来工作将改进邻域近似以支持十亿级规模图上的可扩展攻击策略。

title: Quantitative Introspection in Language Models: Tracking Internal States Across Conversation
summary: Tracking the internal states of large language models across conversations is important for safety, interpretability, and model welfare, yet current methods are limited. Linear probes and other white-box methods compress high-dimensional representations imperfectly and are harder to apply with increasing model size. Taking inspiration from human psychology, where numeric self-report is a widely used tool for tracking internal states, we ask whether LLMs' own numeric self-reports can track probe-defined emotive states over time. We study four concept pairs (wellbeing, interest, focus, and impulsivity) in 40 ten-turn conversations, operationalizing introspection as the causal informational coupling between a model's self-report and a concept-matched probe-defined internal state. We find that greedy-decoded self-reports collapse outputs to few uninformative values, but introspective capacity can be unmasked by calculating logit-based self-reports. This metric tracks interpretable internal states (Spearman $ρ= 0.40$-$0.76$; isotonic $R^2 = 0.12$-$0.54$ in LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct), follows how those states change over time, and activation steering confirms the coupling is causal. Furthermore, we find that introspection is present at turn 1 but evolves through conversation, and can be selectively improved by steering along one concept to boost introspection for another ($ΔR^2$ up to $0.30$). Crucially, these phenomena scale with model size in some cases, approaching $R^2 \approx 0.93$ in LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, and partially replicate in other model families. Together, these results position numeric self-report as a viable, complementary tool for tracking internal emotive states in conversational AI systems.

AI.tldr: 研究提出使用大语言模型的数值自我报告来追踪其内部情感状态，替代传统的线性探针方法。通过40轮十轮对话实验，发现基于logit的自我报告能有效追踪LLM的内部状态（Spearman ρ=0.40-0.76），且这种方法随模型规模提升效果更好（R²≈0.93）。
AI.motivation: 当前追踪LLM内部状态的方法（如线性探针）存在局限：压缩高维表示不完美，且随模型增大难以应用。借鉴人类心理学中数值自我报告的思路，探索LLM自身是否能报告其内部状态。
AI.method: 研究四个概念对（幸福感、兴趣、专注力、冲动性）在40轮十轮对话中，将内省定义为模型自我报告与概念匹配探针定义内部状态之间的因果信息耦合。比较贪心解码与基于logit的自我报告方法，并通过激活 steering 验证因果性。
AI.result: 贪心解码自我报告收敛至少数无信息值；基于logit的自我报告可追踪可解释内部状态（LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct中Spearman ρ=0.40-0.76，等距R²=0.12-0.54）；能追踪状态随时间变化；激活steering证实因果耦合；内省在第一轮就存在但随对话演变；可通过steering选择性提升（ΔR²最高0.30）；随模型规模提升，在LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct中达R²≈0.93；部分复现于其他模型家族。
AI.conclusion: 数值自我报告是追踪对话AI系统内部情感状态的可行补充工具，为模型可解释性和安全性提供新途径。

title: Elastic Weight Consolidation Done Right for Continual Learning
summary: Weight regularization methods in continual learning (CL) alleviate catastrophic forgetting by assessing and penalizing changes to important model weights. Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is a foundational and widely used approach within this framework that estimates weight importance based on gradients. However, it has consistently shown suboptimal performance. In this paper, we conduct a systematic analysis of importance estimation in EWC from a gradient-based perspective. For the first time, we find that EWC's reliance on the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) results in gradient vanishing and inaccurate importance estimation in certain scenarios. Our analysis also reveals that Memory Aware Synapses (MAS), a variant of EWC, imposes unnecessary constraints on parameters irrelevant to prior tasks, termed the redundant protection. Consequently, both EWC and its variants exhibit fundamental misalignments in estimating weight importance, leading to inferior performance. To tackle these issues, we propose the Logits Reversal (LR) operation, a simple yet effective modification that rectifies EWC's importance estimation. Specifically, reversing the logit values during the calculation of FIM can effectively prevent both gradient vanishing and redundant protection. Extensive experiments across various CL tasks and datasets show that the proposed method significantly outperforms existing EWC and its variants. Therefore, we refer to it as EWC Done Right (EWC-DR).

AI.tldr: 本文分析了EWC（弹性权重整合）在持续学习中性能次优的原因，发现FIM导致梯度消失和冗余保护问题，并提出Logits Reversal操作来修正EWC的重要性估计，显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: EWC是持续学习中缓解灾难性遗忘的经典权重正则化方法，但其性能一直表现不佳，需要找出根本原因并进行改进。
AI.method: 从梯度视角对EWC的重要性估计进行系统性分析，提出Logits Reversal (LR)操作修改FIM计算过程，修正EWC的重要性估计。
AI.result: EWC存在两个关键问题：1) FIM导致梯度消失和不准确的重要性估计；2) MAS产生冗余保护（对无关参数施加不必要的约束）。LR操作可同时解决这两个问题。
AI.conclusion: 提出的EWC Done Right (EWC-DR)在多个CL任务和数据集上显著优于现有EWC及其变体，是一种简单有效的改进方法。

title: Evaluating Model-Free Policy Optimization in Masked-Action Environments via an Exact Blackjack Oracle
summary: Infinite-shoe casino blackjack provides a rigorous, exactly verifiable benchmark for discrete stochastic control under dynamically masked actions. Under a fixed Vegas-style ruleset (S17, 3:2 payout, dealer peek, double on any two, double after split, resplit to four), an exact dynamic programming (DP) oracle was derived over 4,600 canonical decision cells. This oracle yielded ground-truth action values, optimal policy labels, and a theoretical expected value (EV) of -0.00161 per hand. To evaluate sample-efficient policy recovery, three model-free optimizers were trained via simulated interaction: masked REINFORCE with a per-cell exponential moving average baseline, simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA), and the cross-entropy method (CEM). REINFORCE was the most sample-efficient, achieving a 46.37% action-match rate and an EV of -0.04688 after 10^6 hands, outperforming CEM (39.46%, 7.5x10^6 evaluations) and SPSA (38.63%, 4.8x10^6 evaluations). However, all methods exhibited substantial cell-conditional regret, indicating persistent policy-level errors despite smooth reward convergence. This gap shows that tabular environments with severe state-visitation sparsity and dynamic action masking remain challenging, while aggregate reward curves can obscure critical local failures. As a negative control, it was proven and empirically confirmed that under i.i.d. draws without counting, optimal bet sizing collapses to the table minimum. In addition, larger wagers strictly increased volatility and ruin without improving expectation. These results highlight the need for exact oracles and negative controls to avoid mistaking stochastic variability for genuine algorithmic performance.

AI.tldr: 構建二十一點精確DP oracle作為benchmark，評估三種無模型優化器在動態動作遮蔽下的策略學習效率，REINFORCE表現最佳但存在顯著局部策略錯誤， aggregate reward曲線掩蓋關鍵局部失敗。
AI.motivation: 解决二十一點紙牌遊戲中離散隨機控制的benchmark問題，特別是在動態動作遮蔽下的樣本高效策略恢復。研究動機包括：(1) 建立可精確驗證的基準環境；(2) 評估無模型優化器在稀疏狀態訪問和動態動作遮蔽下的表現；(3) 提供負面對照實驗驗證bet sizing策略。
AI.method: 1. 推導4,600個規範決策單元格的精確動態規劃(DP) oracle；2. 訓練三種無模型優化器：masked REINFORCE（帶每單元格指數移動平均baseline）、SPSA、CEM；3. 進行負面對照實驗驗證無計數情況下的最優bet sizing。
AI.result: 理論最優EV為-0.00161每手。REINFORCE在10^6手後達到46.37%動作匹配率和-0.04688的EV；CEM在7.5x10^6次評估後達到39.46%；SPSA在4.8x10^6次評估後達到38.63%。所有方法均表現出顯著的單元格條件遺憾。負面對照證實無計數時最優bet sizing收縮至桌面最小值，更大投注僅增加波動性和破產風險。
AI.conclusion: 表格環境中嚴重狀態訪問稀疏性和動態動作遮蔽仍具挑戰性；聚合reward曲線可能掩蓋關鍵局部失敗；需要精確oracles和負面對照實驗避免將隨機變異誤認為真正的算法性能。

title: Secure Linear Alignment of Large Language Models
summary: Language models increasingly appear to learn similar representations, despite differences in training objectives, architectures, and data modalities. This emerging compatibility between independently trained models introduces new opportunities for cross-model alignment to downstream objectives. Moreover, it unlocks new potential application domains, such as settings where security, privacy, or competitive constraints prohibit direct data or model sharing. In this work, we propose a privacy-preserving framework that exploits representational convergence to enable cross-silo inference between independent language models. The framework learns an affine transformation over a shared public dataset and applies homomorphic encryption to protect client queries during inference. By encrypting only the linear alignment and classification operations, the method achieves sub-second inference latency while maintaining strong security guarantees. We support this framework with an empirical investigation into representational convergence, in which we learn linear transformations between the final hidden states of independent models. We evaluate these cross-model mappings on embedding classification and out-of-distribution detection, observing minimal performance degradation across model pairs. Additionally, we show for the first time that linear alignment sometimes enables text generation across independently trained models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用模型表征收敛性的隐私保护跨模型推理框架，通过在共享公共数据集上学习仿射变换，并应用同态加密保护客户端查询，实现独立训练语言模型之间的安全推理。
AI.motivation: 语言模型虽训练目标、架构和数据模态不同，但学习到的表征具有相似性。这种表征收敛性为跨模型对齐提供了机会，同时在安全、隐私或竞争约束禁止直接数据/模型共享的场景中具有应用潜力。
AI.method: 1. 研究表征收敛性：学习独立模型最终隐藏状态之间的线性变换；2. 隐私保护框架：对共享公共数据集学习仿射变换，推理时仅对线性对齐和分类操作应用同态加密。
AI.result: 1. 推理延迟低于1秒，同时保持强安全保证；2. 在嵌入分类和分布外检测任务上，跨模型映射性能降级极小；3. 首次证明线性对齐可实现独立训练模型间的文本生成。
AI.conclusion: 独立训练的语言模型之间存在可利用的表征收敛性，通过线性对齐和同态加密可在保护隐私前提下实现跨模型推理，具有实际应用价值。

title: Enhancing Multi-Corpus Training in SSL-Based Anti-Spoofing Models: Domain-Invariant Feature Extraction
summary: The performance of speech spoofing detection often varies across different training and evaluation corpora. Leveraging multiple corpora typically enhances robustness and performance in fields like speaker recognition and speech recognition. However, our spoofing detection experiments show that multi-corpus training does not consistently improve performance and may even degrade it. We hypothesize that dataset-specific biases impair generalization, leading to performance instability. To address this, we propose an Invariant Domain Feature Extraction (IDFE) framework, employing multi-task learning and a gradient reversal layer to minimize corpus-specific information in learned embeddings. The IDFE framework reduces the average equal error rate by 20% compared to the baseline, assessed across four varied datasets.

AI.tldr: 语音欺骗检测中，多语料库训练由于数据集特定的偏差反而可能导致性能下降。为解决此问题，提出Invariant Domain Feature Extraction (IDFE)框架，使用多任务学习和梯度反转层减少嵌入中的语料库特定信息。
AI.motivation: 语音欺骗检测的性能在不同训练和评估语料库之间存在差异，多语料库训练本应增强鲁棒性，但实验表明其并不总是能提升性能，甚至可能降低性能。研究者假设数据集特定的偏差会损害泛化能力，导致性能不稳定。
AI.method: 提出Invariant Domain Feature Extraction (IDFE)框架，采用多任务学习（multi-task learning）和梯度反转层（gradient reversal layer）来最小化学习到的嵌入中的语料库特定信息。
AI.result: IDFE框架在四个不同数据集上评估，与基线相比，平均等错误率（EER）降低了20%。
AI.conclusion: IDFE框架通过减少语料库特定偏差，有效提升了语音欺骗检测的泛化能力和鲁棒性，在跨语料库场景中表现出更好的性能稳定性。

title: Agentic Business Process Management: A Research Manifesto
summary:
This paper presents a manifesto that articulates the conceptual foundations of Agentic Business Process Management (APM), an extension of Business Process Management (BPM) for governing autonomous agents executing processes in organizations. From a management perspective, APM represents a paradigm shift from the traditional process view of the business process, driven by the realization of process awareness and an agent-oriented abstraction, where software and human agents act as primary functional entities that perceive, reason, and act within explicit process frames. This perspective marks a shift from traditional, automation-oriented BPM toward systems in which autonomy is constrained, aligned, and made operational through process awareness.
  We introduce the core abstractions and architectural elements required to realize APM systems and elaborate on four key capabilities that such APM agents must support: framed autonomy, explainability, conversational actionability, and self-modification. These capabilities jointly ensure that agents' goals are aligned with organizational goals and that agents behave in a framed yet proactive manner in pursuing those goals. We discuss the extent to which the capabilities can be realized and identify research challenges whose resolution requires further advances in BPM, AI, and multi-agent systems. The manifesto thus serves as a roadmap for bridging these communities and for guiding the development of APM systems in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇由 BPM 与自主智能体领域学界与产业界专家联合撰写的"研究宣言"(manifesto)，提出并系统化"Agentic Business Process Management (APM)"范式：把软件智能体与人类智能体视为业务过程的一等功能实体，在显式的"过程框架(frame)"内自主感知、推理与行动。文章给出核心定义(APM 系统、智能体、工具、框架)、宏(macro,系统级/过程感知)与微(micro,智能体级/Perceive–Reason–Act)两层概念架构，并深入阐述四项关键能力：framed autonomy(受约束的自主性)、explainability(可解释性)、conversational actionability(会话可行动性)、self-modification(自修改，区分 adaptation 与 evolution)，同时指出实现路径与研究挑战。
AI.motivation: 大模型与 agentic AI 让软件系统逐步获得自主性(独立感知、推理、行动以达成目标)，可降低知识工作负担、缓解人力短缺并提升效率与竞争力。但自主性也带来风险：业务层面可能违反合规规则、漠视社会规范或造成不利业务结果；技术层面 LLM 的功能不确定性难以测试与调试，导致系统集成、维护与技术债问题。已有的智能体治理研究源于规范性多智能体系统(规范、许可、禁令)与厂商实践指南，但缺少与"组织中管理工作的成熟视角"的桥梁。而 BPM 正是这一视角：它关注协调地完成组织目标的活动集合的管理。虽然 BPM 与 MAS 在 1990 年代起有联合传统，但多数工作仅将智能体视为执行任务的分配对象，而非作为"一等公民"来治理以确保业务目标达成；过程编排(process choreography)、智能体系统挖掘、agentic AI 过程可观测性等方向虽有涉及，仍缺乏整体性视角。BPM 从业者对"何为智能体"及其收益与风险也缺乏清晰认识，存在洞察被忽视与机会错失的问题。
AI.method: 采用宣言式(positional/manifesto)方法：由 BPM 理论界、形式化方法界与产业界(IBM Research、SAP、Meta)专家组成联合立场。共识形成过程依托 Dagstuhl 研讨会 #25192 (AUTOBIZ) 的专家报告与分组讨论(bullet groups)成果，再经 PMAI'25 (ECAI 2025) 工作坊论文同行评审迭代([9,26,54,23])，最终整合为本宣言。方法论上综合并对齐多个既有知识体系：上层基础本体 DOLCE、GFO；智能体导向建模框架 i*、Tropos；经典 AI 构件 BDI、FIPA；心智模型理论(mental model theory of reasoning)；以及作者本人此前提出的 AI-Augmented BPM Systems(ABPMS)框架中的 framing 概念。作者在概念架构图(Figure 1)上区分 macro(APM 系统，过程感知与目标对齐的建立)与 micro(APM 智能体，Perceive–Reason–Act 循环)两层；在 framing 讨论中进一步区分 normative frame(规范框架：deontic 要求、义务/许可/禁止)与 operational frame(操作框架：BPMN 式命令式控制流、DECLARE 式声明式约束)，并区分自动化(automation)与自主性(autonomy)。为刻画 framed autonomy 的问题设定，文章区分集中式智能(单决策者、过程级框架、环境随机且部分可观测)与分布式智能(多决策者作为资源、部分可观测、目标可能冲突)，由此导出三种蓝图场景。解释性属性方面借鉴 situation-aware explainability 与因果过程(causal processes)研究提出四项理想性质；自修改部分则区分适应(adaptation，短时、实例级、临时)与演化(evolution，长时、跨实例、永久、修改过程模型/策略)并建立二者反馈循环。
AI.result: 1) 核心定义：APM 系统是由一组智能体(部分具备过程感知)共同实现的社会技术系统；APM 智能体是"感知—推理—行动"的主要执行实体，其自主性被"框架"所约束以保证过程感知并达成过程目标；工具是扩展智能体感知/推理/行动能力的手段(传感器、执行器、消息、服务)。2) 概念架构：宏层通过 framing 机制(含过程感知与目标对齐，含生命周期管理与角色/职责分离)约束并对齐智能体；微层由感知模块、推理模块(含心智模型与意圖模型)、行动模块三部分组成，每个过程感知智能体运行在受框架约束的知识与目标之上的 PRA 循环，并通过共享语言/本体/协议(MCP、ACP、RDF、KQML)交互。3) 四项能力：framed autonomy 通过 normative/operational frame 组合在保证合规前提下保留行为自由度，其局部化还充当安全与隐私边界；explainability 支撑信任、问责、偏见检测与 GDPR/AI Act 合规，并从两个方向支撑自主性(自主消解其他智能体 misalignment、降低人工干预)；conversational actionability 包含过程感知会话与过程感知可行动性，由各智能体基于自身 frame 联邦式地实现，需共识消解，覆盖 Query/Recommend/Create/Execute 四类行为；self-modification 区分适应与演化并构成闭环(适应产生执行轨迹→学习→被纳入过程模型成为演化；演化减少已知失效模式的适应频次)，同时要求演化变更在所有相关智能体间重新对齐传播。4) 研究挑战：需为 frames 与 goals 建立一等的形式化抽象(过程心智模型、目标、规范框架)并开发可证明 frame-compliant 的操作规格合成算法；实现过程/智能体/MAS 三层动态可调的解释；研究智能体与人类主体、工具及传统过程感知系统的会话机制与自主-控制权衡；以及自我适应的治理框架与系统性后果评估。5) 与既有愿景的关系：ABPMS 的 framing 概念为前驱但隐含智能体视角；augmented process execution 的四级分析金字塔与 Large Process Models 为互补(并指出即使有人类在环，当前 LLM 也不足以支撑真正自改进过程)；Process Mining Manifesto 被视为 BPM 社区"宣言传统"的先例。
AI.conclusion: APM 代表从"以自动化为导向的 BPM"向"以自主智能体为一等功能实体、在显式过程框架内被约束、被对齐并可运作的系统的范式转变；其四项能力(受框架约束的自主性、可解释性、会话可行动性、自修改)共同保证智能体目标与组织目标对齐，并支持"既被约束又主动"的行动方式。作者有意保持关键机制的实现开放(process-awareness/framing 的具体工程实现、框架化知识与目标的表示、解释/会话/自修改能力的技术落地)，把论文定位为 BPM、AI 与多智能体系统三社区之间的路线图与研究号召：呼吁形式化基础(具备原则性保证)、可复用软件构件与可复现实证评测(基于系统基准)、并最终评估对商业与社会价值；强调 APM 的智能体范畴不应局限于 LLM 驱动的"生成式 AI 智能体"，还须包含对组织与社会成功至关紧要的人类智能体。

title: Revisiting Label Inference Attacks in Vertical Federated Learning: Why They Are Vulnerable and How to Defend
summary: Vertical federated learning (VFL) allows an active party with a top model, and multiple passive parties with bottom models to collaborate. In this scenario, passive parties possessing only features may attempt to infer active party's private labels, making label inference attacks (LIAs) a significant threat. Previous LIA studies have claimed that well-trained bottom models can effectively represent labels. However, we demonstrate that this view is misleading and exposes the vulnerability of existing LIAs. By leveraging mutual information, we present the first observation of the "model compensation" phenomenon in VFL. We theoretically prove that, in VFL, the mutual information between layer outputs and labels increases with layer depth, indicating that bottom models primarily extract feature information while the top model handles label mapping. Building on this insight, we introduce task reassignment to show that the success of existing LIAs actually stems from the distribution alignment between features and labels. When this alignment is disrupted, the performance of LIAs declines sharply or even fails entirely. Furthermore, the implications of this insight for defenses are also investigated. We propose a zero-overhead defense technique based on layer adjustment. Extensive experiments across five datasets and five representative model architectures indicate that shifting cut layers forward to increase the proportion of top model layers in the entire model not only improves resistance to LIAs but also enhances other defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文首次揭示了垂直联邦学习(VFL)中标签推断攻击(LIA)的真实机制。通过互信息分析，发现现有研究对底部模型能有效表示标签的观点具有误导性。底部模型主要提取特征信息，顶部模型处理标签映射。攻击成功的真正原因是特征与标签之间的分布对齐，而非底部模型对标签的表示能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LIA研究声称训练有素的底部模型可以有效表示标签，但这一观点存在误导性且暴露了现有LIAs的脆弱性。需要重新理解VFL中标签推断攻击的真实机制。
AI.method: 1. 利用互信息分析VFL中的"模型补偿"现象；2. 理论证明层输出与标签之间的互信息随层深度增加；3. 引入任务重新分配(task reassignment)来验证攻击机制；4. 提出基于层调整的零开销防御技术。
AI.result: 1. 理论证明：在VFL中，层输出与标签的互信息随层深度增加；2. 发现现有LIAs的成功源于特征与标签之间的分布对齐，当这种对齐被破坏时，LIAs性能急剧下降甚至完全失败；3. 层调整防御：将切割层前移以增加顶部模型在整体模型中的比例，不仅能增强对LIAs的抵抗能力，还能提升其他防御效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过互信息分析揭示了VFL中标签推断攻击的真实机制——分布对齐而非底部模型标签表示。基于此提出的零开销层调整防御技术在5个数据集和5种模型架构上验证有效，为VFL安全提供了新的理论视角和实用防御方案。

title: Teleological Inference in Structural Causal Models via Intentional Interventions
summary: Structural causal models (SCMs) were conceived to formulate and answer causal questions. This paper shows that SCMs can also be used to formulate and answer teleological questions, concerning the intentions of a state-aware, goal-directed agent intervening in a causal system. We review limitations of previous approaches to modeling such agents, and then introduce intentional interventions, a new time-agnostic operator that induces a twin SCM we call a structural final model (SFM). SFMs treat observed values as the outcome of intentional interventions and relate them to the counterfactual conditions of those interventions (what would have happened had the agent not intervened). We show how SFMs can be used to empirically detect agents and to discover their intentions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将结构因果模型(SCM)应用于目的论问题的研究,引入"意向性干预"算子和"结构最终模型(SFM)",用于建模具有目标导向的智能体及其意图,并展示了该方法在检测智能体和发现其意图方面的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在建模具有目标导向的智能体方面存在局限性,作者认为SCM不仅可以用于回答因果问题,还可以扩展到目的论问题的建模,即关于有意图的目标导向智能体干预因果系统的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的时间无关算子——意向性干预(intentional intervention),该算子产生一个"孪生SCM",称为结构最终模型(SFM)。SFM将观察值视为意向性干预的结果,并将其与反事实条件(若智能体未干预会发生什么)联系起来。
AI.result: SFM框架能够经验性地检测智能体的存在,并发现其意图。作者通过理论分析展示了该方法的可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: SCM框架具有更广泛的应用潜力,可用于目的论问题的形式化建模,为理解和检测目标导向智能体提供了新的理论工具和方法。

title: HISR: Hindsight Information Modulated Segmental Process Rewards For Multi-turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: While large language models excel in diverse domains, their performance on complex longhorizon agentic decision-making tasks remains limited. Most existing methods concentrate on designing effective reward models (RMs) to advance performance via multi-turn reinforcement learning. However, they suffer from delayed propagation in sparse outcome rewards and unreliable credit assignment with potentially overly fine-grained and unfocused turnlevel process rewards. In this paper, we propose (HISR) exploiting Hindsight Information to modulate Segmental process Rewards, which closely aligns rewards with sub-goals and underscores significant segments to enhance the reliability of credit assignment. Specifically, a segment-level process RM is presented to assign rewards for each sub-goal in the task, avoiding excessively granular allocation to turns. To emphasize significant segments in the trajectory, a hindsight model is devised to reflect the preference of performing a certain action after knowing the trajectory outcome. With this characteristic, we design the ratios of sequence likelihoods between hindsight and policy model to measure action importance. The ratios are subsequently employed to aggregate segment importance scores, which in turn modulate segmental process rewards, enhancing credit assignment reliability. Extensive experimental results on three publicly benchmarks demonstrate the validity of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HISR方法，通过利用后见信息来调节分段过程奖励，以解决大型语言模型在复杂长程决策任务中性能受限的问题。该方法针对现有方法中奖励信号延迟传播和信用分配不可靠的缺陷，通过分段级过程奖励模型和后见模型来增强信用分配的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在复杂长程智能体决策任务中性能受限。现有的多轮强化学习方法主要关注设计有效的奖励模型，但面临两个主要问题：1) 稀疏结果奖励存在延迟传播问题；2) 过于细粒度且缺乏焦点的轮级过程奖励导致信用分配不可靠。
AI.method: 提出HISR方法，包含两个核心组件：1) 分段级过程奖励模型：为任务中的每个子目标分配奖励，避免过度细粒度地分配到单个轮次；2) 后见模型：反映在知道轨迹结果后执行某动作的偏好，用于衡量动作重要性。具体使用后见模型与策略模型的序列似然比来测量动作重要性，然后将这些比率用于聚合分段重要性分数，从而调节分段过程奖励。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准测试上的广泛实验结果证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过后见信息调节分段过程奖励的方法能够更好地将奖励与子目标对齐，强调重要分段，从而增强信用分配的可靠性，提升大型语言模型在复杂长程决策任务中的性能。

title: Evaluating 5W3H Structured Prompting for Intent Alignment in Human-AI Interaction
comment: 27 pages, figures, tables, and appendix. Primary category: human-computer interaction / human-AI interaction. Public artifact repository and implementation resources are referenced in the manuscript
summary: Natural language prompts often suffer from intent transmission loss: the gap between what users actually need and what they communicate to AI systems. We evaluate PPS (Prompt Protocol Specification), a 5W3H-based framework for structured intent representation in human-AI interaction. In a controlled three-condition study across 60 tasks in three domains (business, technical, and travel), three large language models (DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-Max, and Kimi), and three prompt conditions - (A) simple prompts, (B) raw PPS JSON, and (C) natural-language-rendered PPS - we collect 540 AI-generated outputs evaluated by an LLM judge. We introduce goal_alignment, a user-intent-centered evaluation dimension, and find that rendered PPS outperforms both simple prompts and raw JSON on this metric. PPS gains are task-dependent: gains are large in high-ambiguity business analysis tasks but reverse in low-ambiguity travel planning. We also identify a measurement asymmetry in standard LLM evaluation, where unconstrained prompts can inflate constraint adherence scores and mask the practical value of structured prompting. A preliminary retrospective survey (N = 20) further suggests a 66.1% reduction in follow-up prompts required, from 3.33 to 1.13 rounds. These findings suggest that structured intent representations can improve alignment and usability in human-AI interaction, especially in tasks where user intent is inherently ambiguous.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了PPS（Prompt Protocol Specification）——一个基于5W3H的结构化意图表示框架。研究在60项任务、3个领域（商业、技术、旅行）、3个LLM（DeepSeek-V3、Qwen-Max、Kimi）与3种提示条件（简单提示 / 原始PPS JSON / 自然语言渲染的PPS）下收集540条AI输出，并由LLM评审员打分。结果表明：自然语言渲染的PPS在以用户意图为中心的 goal_alignment 维度上优于简单提示与原始JSON；PPS的收益具有任务依赖性——在高歧义商业分析任务中收益显著，但在低歧义旅行规划中效果反转；此外发现标准LLM评估存在"测量不对称"现象，无约束提示会虚高约束遵循度得分，掩盖结构化提示的实际价值；一项回顾性初步调查（N=20）显示后续追问轮次从3.33降至1.13，减少66.1%。
AI.motivation: 自然语言提示在人与AI交互中存在"意图传输损失"（intent transmission loss）——用户实际需求与其向AI系统所传达内容之间的落差，导致模型输出偏离真实意图。作者希望检验一种结构化的意图表示范式（PPS）是否以及在何种条件下能缩小该差距，并同时反思当前以约束遵循度为核心的LLM评估指标是否存在系统性偏差。
AI.method: 采用受控三条件实验设计：60项任务（商业分析、技术、旅行规划三个领域）、3个模型（DeepSeek-V3、Qwen-Max、Kimi）、3种提示条件（A简单提示、B原始PPS JSON、C自然语言渲染的PPS），共生成540条输出，由LLM评审（LLM-as-judge）评分。核心创新是引入用户意图中心的评估维度 goal_alignment，与传统指标（如约束遵循度）并列比较，以揭示评估中的测量不对称。补充一项N=20的回顾性调查，测量用户后续追问轮次以评估可用性收益。
AI.result: 1) 在 goal_alignment 上，渲染后的PPS（C）显著优于简单提示（A）与原始JSON（B），说明结构化意图需以自然语言形式表达才能被模型有效利用，直接抛出JSON反而无益；2) 收益具有任务依赖性：高歧义商业分析任务中PPS增益最大，而在低歧义旅行规划任务中增益反转（简单提示更优），即结构化提示的价值随意图歧义度上升；3) 发现测量不对称：无约束的简单提示会人为抬高约束遵循度得分，使结构化提示的实用价值在既有指标下被掩盖；4) 回顾性调查显示后续追问轮次由3.33降至1.13（-66.1%），表明PPS提升了交互效率与一次成型可用性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的意图表示（PPS）能在高歧义任务中提升人机对齐与可用性，任务歧义度是决定其收益的关键调节变量；同时提示评估方法论需要修正——应引入以用户意图为中心的指标（如goal_alignment），避免无约束提示在约束遵循度上的虚高效应误导结论。作者建议以自然语言渲染形式（而非原始JSON）落地PPS，并按任务歧义度选择是否使用结构化提示。局限包括：LLM-as-judge评分的主观性与自动评审偏差、每条件60项任务的统计功效有限、调查样本量小（N=20）且为回顾性设计、仅覆盖三个模型与三个领域，跨模型与跨语言的泛化性有待验证。

title: STEP: Scientific Time-Series Encoder Pretraining via Cross-Domain Distillation
summary: Scientific time series are central to scientific AI but are typically sparse, highly heterogeneous, and limited in scale, making unified representation learning particularly challenging. Meanwhile, foundation models pretrained on relevant time series domains such as audio, general time series, and brain signals contain rich knowledge, but their applicability to scientific signals remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate the transferability and complementarity of foundation models from relevant time series domains, and study how to effectively leverage them to build a unified encoder for scientific time series. We first systematically evaluate relevant foundation models, showing the effectiveness of knowledge transfer to scientific tasks and their complementary strengths. Based on this observation, we propose STEP, a Scientific Time Series Encoder Pretraining framework via cross domain distillation. STEP introduces adaptive patching to handle extreme-length sequences and a statistics compensation scheme to accommodate diverse numerical scales. It further leverages cross-domain distillation to integrate knowledge from multiple foundation models into a unified encoder. By combining complementary representations across different domains, STEP learns general-purpose and transferable features tailored for scientific signals. Experiments on seven scientific time series tasks demonstrate that STEP provides both an effective structure and an effective pretraining paradigm, taking a STEP toward scientific time series representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEP框架，通过跨域蒸馏将音频、通用时序和脑信号等领域的预训练基础模型知识迁移到科学时序数据，学习可迁移的通用特征表示。
AI.motivation: 科学时序数据通常稀疏、异构且规模有限，统一的表示学习面临挑战；而来自相关领域（音频、通用时序、脑信号）的基础模型包含丰富知识，但其对科学信号的适用性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: STEP框架包含三个核心组件：1）自适应分块（adaptive patching）处理超长序列；2）统计补偿机制（statistics compensation）适应不同数值尺度；3）跨域蒸馏（cross-domain distillation）将多个基础模型的知识整合到统一编码器中。
AI.result: 在7个科学时序任务上的实验表明，STEP有效证明了跨域知识迁移的可行性和各基础模型的互补优势。
AI.conclusion: STEP为科学时序表示学习提供了有效的模型结构和预训练范式，是向科学时序表示学习迈出的重要一步。

title: Unmasking Algorithmic Bias in Predictive Policing: A GAN-Based Simulation Framework with Multi-City Temporal Analysis
summary:
Predictive policing systems that direct patrol resources based on algorithmically generated crime forecasts have been widely deployed across US cities, yet their tendency to encode and amplify racial disparities remains poorly understood in quantitative terms. We present a reproducible simulation framework that couples a Generative Adversarial Network GAN with a Noisy OR patrol detection model to measure how racial bias propagates through the full enforcement pipeline from crime occurrence to police contact. Using 145000 plus Part 1 crime records from Baltimore 2017 to 2019 and 233000 plus records from Chicago 2022, augmented with US Census ACS demographic data, we compute four monthly bias metrics across 264 city year mode observations: the Disparate Impact Ratio DIR, Demographic Parity Gap, Gini Coefficient, and a composite Bias Amplification Score.
  Our experiments reveal extreme and year variant bias in Baltimores detected mode, with mean annual DIR up to 15714 in 2019, moderate under detection of Black residents in Chicago DIR equals 0.22, and persistent Gini coefficients of 0.43 to 0.62 across all conditions. We further demonstrate that a Conditional Tabular GAN CTGAN debiasing approach partially redistributes detection rates but cannot eliminate structural disparity without accompanying policy intervention. Socioeconomic regression analysis confirms strong correlations between neighborhood racial composition and detection likelihood Pearson r equals 0.83 for percent White and r equals negative 0.81 for percent Black. A sensitivity analysis over patrol radius, officer count, and citizen reporting probability reveals that outcomes are most sensitive to officer deployment levels. The code and data are publicly available at this repository.

AI.tldr: 本文是对一篇"GAN + Noisy OR 巡警探测"预测性警务模拟框架的可复现修订版审计：重建了正确的地理坐标、官方人口普查 (ACS) 人口统计分区标签、一致的计数型估计量与显式的"观测流"（仅巡逻探测 / 混合报案 / 全记录参照），并用 20 个随机种子在巴尔的摩 2017–2019 与芝加哥 2022 上重复模拟。修订版推翻了原版若干头条结论（如 DIR≈15714、"CTGAN 去偏需政策干预"、"邻里回归 r=0.83/-0.81"），代之以更保守的结论：探测流反馈使绝对差距扩大 1.5–2.1 个百分点；CTGAN 合成替换在 220 个 seed-month 拟合中有 107 个失败、无任何完整年度轨迹，故无法给出年度去偏估计；该模拟既不测量个体层面的种族差异，也不识别未记录犯罪的分布。
AI.motivation: 预测性警务系统依据算法生成的犯罪预测分配巡逻资源，已广泛部署于美国城市，但算法在"犯罪发生—警方接触"全流程中如何编码与放大空间（准）种族差异，缺乏可量化、可复现的审计工具。原版论文（arXiv 早期版本）报告了极端的差异影响比（如 2019 年 DIR≈15714）、邻域回归相关系数 r=0.83 与"CTGAN 去偏需配套政策干预"等结论，但这些结论存在统计构造缺陷（零分母、epsilon 稳定化、区域类别均值回填结果变量、空间协变量来源不明、距离单位错误、估计量不一致）。本文的目的因此有两层：(1) 对既有定量结论做审计性复核，区分"存档记录""模拟观测""地点人口特征"三者；(2) 提供一个修订后的、可复现的、以显式观测流为核心的模拟审计框架，并说明该框架能与不能回答什么问题（避免把模拟出的探测差异等同于个体层面的种族歧视、实际警务效果或未记录犯罪分布）。
AI.method: 【数据】冻结的四份处理后事件档案：巴尔的摩 2017/2018/2019 年 51511/47856/45811 条、芝加哥 2022 年 234882 条；经市政分析掩膜后保留 145142 与 234073 条。以 SHA 哈希冻结，原始抽取日志不可得（仅对一条芝加哥记录做点检）。【地理协变量】坐标经空间连接至人口普查区划，附 ACS 5 年估计（B02001 种族、B19013 收入、B17001 贫困）；Black/White 单一族裔占比 >50% 划为 Black/White 多数区，否则为 Other；零人口/缺失/未匹配为 Unknown；不填补城市均值。巴尔的摩用 2019 年协变量回溯分类三年；未传播 ACS 估计与 50% 阈值的不确定性。【物理探测模型】坐标投影为米（EPSG:26985/26971），每月 60 个巡逻点，事件 i 在 700 英尺（213.36 m）内的巡逻点数 k_i 决定 p_i = 1-(1-0.85)^{k_i}，D_i ~ Bernoulli(p_i)；市民报案 C_i ~ Bernoulli(0.521)，混合流 M_i = D_i ∨ C_i（假设报案空间均匀且与探测独立）。【时间排序】每年 1 月初始化（1 月全部记录），2 月用 1 月训练、3 月用 2 月，依此至 12 月；当月结果不进入当月训练；三年为独立年度序列而非连续三年反馈轨迹；观测训练集 <10 条时沿用最近一次可用集并记录。【生成模型】GAN：生成器 100 维高斯潜变量→全连接 256/512/256/2，BatchNorm+LeakyReLU(0.2)+tanh；判别器 512/256/128、dropout 0.3、单 logit；真实与生成坐标共享固定包围盒变换以修正原版 tanh 与标准化真实坐标的不匹配；Adam lr=2e-4、系数 (0.5, 0.999)、每次月度拟合 200 次更新（每步至多 64 条有放回抽样）、BCE-with-logits；生成器置 eval 后采样，落在掩膜外者拒绝并记录拒绝比例。基线：empirical（上月训练坐标有放回抽样）与 uniform-area（城市多边形均匀采样）。【估计量】分区组探测率 = 模拟探测数 / 该类别档案记录数（分区级、非人均）；主指标为 Black 减 White 百万分点差 Δ_s 及绝对差对比 A_s = |Δ_observed| - |Δ_reference|；总覆盖率 = 探测记录/全部记录（含 Unknown）；次要为率比 r_B/r_W（零分母保留为 ∞/未定义并计数，不做 epsilon 替换）与三组非加权 Gini；删去原版复合"Bias Amplification Score"。【不确定性】20 个种子（100–119）× 7 条件（3 观测流 × 生成/经验 + uniform）= 560 条 2–12 月轨迹、6160 次月度策略评估；同种子配对；4000 次整轨迹 bootstrap 给出 95% 区间，月度图 2000 次整轨迹重采样给逐点带；报告 MCSE，>0.5 pp 标记为不精确；同一政策与自身参照轨迹做配对反馈对比。【探索性关联】按 tract-month 拟合分数二项 logit（响应为种子均值探测比例，权重为该 tract-month 档案记录数；预测变量含 Black 占比每 10pp、对数中位收入、贫困占比、对数记录密度、月份与年份指示），采用种子与 1.5/3/6 km 空间块重采样（主规格 3 km，250 次）并保留 6 近邻残差 Moran 统计。【合成替换实验】巴尔的摩 2019 滚动参照：raw / 简单平衡替换（保留约 70% 真实记录，按三类等量补齐，类别差异至多 1 条）/ CTGAN 替换（每已知类至多 600 条真实记录，200 轮，batch 500，packing 10，类别均衡采样；提案必须同时带有所请求类别且落在该实际地理类别的 tract 内，每目标组至多 20 个提案批次；未达标记为不可行，禁止错标填补或静默丢弃）。【敏感性】5 个配对种子下变动半径（400/1000/1500 ft）、警员数（30/90/120）、单车探测概率（0.5/0.95）、报案概率（0.3/0.8），以及 1000 次更新的训练预算实验。
AI.result: 【原版结论审计】原 264 行模拟结果实为 88 个"月×模式"单元 × 3 个区域类别，来自 8 条年度序列；所谓邻里回归表有 279 行但只有 3 个不同结果值（由区域类别均值回填），故相关与 OLS 估计被剔除。巴尔的摩 2019 原 detected 流有 8 个月 White 类别探测为 0；按存档计数汇总为 Black 类 800/32939（2.43%）对 White 类 53/7924（0.67%），合并比 3.63——这是对旧计数在旧标签下的审计，与原文报道的"月均 epsilon 稳定化比≈15714"并非同一量，说明聚合方式与零值处理足以主导头条统计。【主结果】检测流训练下生成策略的合并平均差距：巴尔的摩 2017 为 0.75 [-0.69, 2.26] pp，2018 为 -2.03 [-2.86, -1.19] pp，2019 为 -1.11 [-2.42, 0.31] pp，芝加哥 2022 为 -0.19 [-1.35, 0.83] pp（95% 整轨迹 bootstrap 区间）；符号均值不覆盖种子层面的方向全貌，28 个条件均值中有 7 个差距 MCSE 超过预设的 0.5 pp 标记线，说明 20 种子预算下精度并不一致。全记录参照下，经验抽样在所有城市-年份中的总探测覆盖率均高于生成策略（如巴尔的摩 2017：8.26% vs 4.73%；芝加哥 2022：3.16% vs 1.55%），但覆盖率高并不等于公平。【反馈对比】生成策略下"仅探测"输入相对参照使合并绝对差距平均扩大 1.53–2.11 pp（各城市-年份的配对 bootstrap 区间均高于 0），同时覆盖率提高 0.23–2.63 pp；"混合"流的绝对差距变化为 -0.23 至 0.09 pp，各区间均包含 0，因此仅能区分两类模拟观测流，不能对市民报案或警务作普遍性断言。参照流下生成策略的下一月空间散度（Jensen–Shannon，12×12 网格、512 采样点）为 0.121–0.159，经验抽样为 0.023–0.040 且在每个城市-年份都更低，说明在该训练预算下对抗式生成未显示预测价值优势；生成模型并非产生差距的必要条件。【合成替换】简单替换平均差距 0.15 [-0.20, 0.49] pp、覆盖率 5.12 [4.92, 5.34]%，原始训练为 0.54 pp / 4.87%，配对绝对差距变化 -0.04 pp [-0.38, 0.27]，即在当前预算下未显示明确缩减。CTGAN 替换在 220 个 seed-month 拟合中仅 113 个达标、107 个失败，20 条种子中 0 条完整，年度去偏效应"不可估计"；未过滤提案的标签/地理一致率均值仅 29.5%，被接受提案比例均值 6.6%。【tract 层关联】6456 个巴尔的摩 tract-month（196 tract）与 8703 个芝加哥 tract-month（817 tract）；3 km 块下 Black 占比每 10pp 的优势比区间在四个规格中均包含 1（巴尔的摩 detected 0.866 [0.773, 1.014]、mixed 0.973 [0.938, 1.038]；芝加哥 detected 0.999 [0.941, 1.071]、mixed 0.997 [0.969, 1.025]），残差 Moran 统计 0.63–0.67 表明残余空间关联仍显著，故仅作探索性描述，不构成人口统计解释部署差距的独立证据。【训练预算】巴尔的摩 2019 五种子子集下 1000 次更新替代 200 次：detected -1.30 pp、mixed -0.05 pp、reference +0.03 pp，提示结果依赖模型规格设定。
AI.conclusion: 本文的可辩护贡献是一套可复现的空间模拟审计：把观测流作为显式组件，从而把"反馈对比"与普通时间波动区分开；用绝对差距与覆盖率并列报告，防止"看起来有利的比率"掩盖各群体极低的探测；用地理一致性检验防止把类别标签当成经验证的空间人口属性；并让合成失败、零分母、模型拟合度、覆盖率与残余不确定性可见。其边界被反复强调：档案记录不等于潜在犯罪；巴尔的摩与芝加哥在罪案范围与日历期上不可比（三段独立年度序列 vs 单一年份，不能归因于城市效应或历史变化）；tract 人口统计是生态代理（Other 为异质集合，ACS 与 50% 阈值带来额外测量误差）；固定月度点位部署与齐次 Noisy-OR 概率省略了巡逻移动、时空可得性、执法裁量、受害者报案差异与制度决策；1 月全量观测与稀疏数据顺延规则是明示建模选择；生成器是固定更新预算的原型，采样有效性、收敛性与空间保真度需先行评估；20 个种子只刻画有限的随机实现分布。据此，作者撤回了原版"合成实验证明需要配套政策干预"的结论，并明确本文不测量抑制效应、错误警务接触、保护效果、逮捕或任何真实干预的效果；模拟中更高或更低的探测，其伦理含义需由模型观察不到的社区与制度语境来界定。此外还撤回/替换了原版依赖 epsilon 稳定化比率、区域均值回填结果变量等做法；建议所有审计报告在比率型公平摘要之外，同时给出绝对探测差、覆盖率、合成可行性与模拟不确定性。

title: OCP: Orthogonal Constrained Projection for Sparse Scaling in Industrial Commodity Recommendation
summary: In industrial commodity recommendation systems, the representation quality of Item-Id vocabularies directly impacts the scalability and generalization ability of recommendation models. A key challenge is that traditional Item-Id vocabularies, when subjected to sparse scaling, suffer from low-frequency information interference, which restricts their expressive power for massive item sets and leads to representation collapse. To address this issue, we propose an Orthogonal Constrained Projection method to optimize embedding representation. By enforcing orthogonality, the projection constrains the backpropagation manifold, aligning the singular value spectrum of the learned embeddings with the orthogonal basis. This alignment ensures high singular entropy, thereby preserving isotropic generalized features while suppressing spurious correlations and overfitting to rare items. Empirical results demonstrate that OCP accelerates loss convergence and enhances the model's scalability; notably, it enables consistent performance gains when scaling up dense layers. Large-scale industrial deployment on JD.com further confirms its efficacy, yielding a 12.97% increase in UCXR and an 8.9% uplift in GMV, highlighting its robust utility for scaling up both sparse vocabularies and dense architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出正交约束投影(OCP)方法解决工业商品推荐系统中Item-Id词表在稀疏扩展时面临的低频信息干扰和表示崩溃问题，通过强制正交性约束反向传播流形，使学习到的嵌入与正交基对齐，保持高奇异熵，从而保留各向同性泛化特征并抑制对稀有项目的过拟合。
